<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<base target="_top">
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#F2F6FB">
<title>VITA × RINA Fitness</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.344.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js" onerror="var s=document.createElement('script');s.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.344.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js';s.onload=function(){lucide.createIcons()};document.head.appendChild(s)"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F2F6FB; --ink:#0B1324; --ink2:#334155; --muted:#7A8699; --line:#E3EAF3;
  --pri:#0EA5E9; --pri2:#22D3EE; --pri-d:#0369A1; --pri-l:#E0F4FD;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#22D3EE 0%,#0EA5E9 50%,#2563EB 100%);
  --mint:#10B981; --mint2:#34D399; --mint-l:#DCFCE9;
  --rose:#F43F5E; --rose2:#FB7185; --rose-l:#FFE4EA;
  --blue:#2563EB; --blue-l:#E6EEFF; --teal:#0D9488; --teal-l:#D5F5F1; --navy:#0F1E3D;
  --r:26px; --sh:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(15,30,61,.28); --sh2:0 6px 20px -10px rgba(15,30,61,.16);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{min-height:100%}
body{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
svg.lucide{width:20px;height:20px;stroke-width:2.1}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.rina-full{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center bottom/contain no-repeat}
.rina-head{background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover no-repeat}

/* ---------- animated mesh background ---------- */
.mesh{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.mesh i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px);opacity:.55;animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite}
.mesh i:nth-child(1){width:380px;height:380px;background:#A5F3FC;top:-140px;right:-120px}
.mesh i:nth-child(2){width:300px;height:300px;background:#BBF7D0;top:38%;left:-160px;animation-delay:-6s}
.mesh i:nth-child(3){width:320px;height:320px;background:#BFDBFE;bottom:-140px;right:-80px;animation-delay:-12s}
@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(30px,40px) scale(1.1)}66%{transform:translate(-20px,20px) scale(.95)}}

/* ---------- PRELOADER ---------- */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;background:radial-gradient(100% 70% at 50% 0%,#E6F7FE,var(--bg) 70%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:20px;transition:opacity .6s var(--ease),visibility .6s}
#loader.out{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
.ld-ring{position:relative;width:150px;height:150px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ld-ring::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,#22D3EE,#0EA5E9,#34D399,#22D3EE);animation:rot 1.6s linear infinite;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 62%,#000 63%);mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 62%,#000 63%)}
.ld-ring::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(14,165,233,.35);animation:ripple 2s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes ripple{0%{transform:scale(.8);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:0}}
.ld-face{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;background-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(14,165,233,.6);animation:bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.ld-ecg{width:180px;height:36px}
.ld-ecg path{fill:none;stroke:url(#gCyan);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-dasharray:300;stroke-dashoffset:300;animation:draw 1.8s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes draw{0%{stroke-dashoffset:300}60%{stroke-dashoffset:0}100%{stroke-dashoffset:-300}}
.ld-brand{font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--navy)}
.ld-brand b{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.ld-tip{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;transition:opacity .3s;min-height:18px}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}

/* ---------- LAYOUT ---------- */
.shell{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;position:relative}
.screen{animation:screenIn .7s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes screenIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.glass{background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.card{border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.anim{opacity:0;animation:cardIn .75s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes cardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ---------- AUTH ---------- */
#auth{min-height:100vh;padding:22px 20px 36px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--navy);font-size:17px}
.brand .lg{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 22px -10px rgba(14,165,233,.9)}
.brand small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.hero{position:relative;height:300px;margin:8px 0 4px}
.hero .halo{position:absolute;left:50%;top:52%;width:250px;height:250px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ECFEFF,#A5F3FC 45%,#7DD3FC 75%,#60A5FA);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -25px rgba(14,165,233,.7)}
.hero .halo::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18px;border-radius:50%;border:2px dashed rgba(14,165,233,.35);animation:rot 30s linear infinite}
.hero .mascot{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:190px;height:290px;transform:translateX(-50%);animation:bob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 18px rgba(15,30,61,.25))}
.fchip{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:16px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;animation:bob 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:2}
.fchip .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.fchip .ic svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.fchip small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.bubble{position:absolute;top:4px;left:0;background:#fff;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:18px 18px 4px 18px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--sh2);white-space:nowrap;animation:pop .8s .6s var(--ease) both;z-index:3}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.auth-title{text-align:center;margin:14px 0 18px}
.auth-title h1{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.15}
.auth-title h1 em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.auth-title p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5}
.auth-card{border-radius:30px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.seg{display:flex;background:#EEF3F9;border-radius:16px;padding:5px;position:relative;margin-bottom:18px}
.seg button{flex:1;padding:11px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:12px;position:relative;z-index:1;color:var(--muted);transition:color .3s}
.seg button.on{color:#fff}
.seg .pill{position:absolute;top:5px;bottom:5px;left:5px;width:calc(50% - 5px);border-radius:12px;background:var(--grad);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -8px rgba(14,165,233,.9);transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.seg.reg .pill{transform:translateX(100%)}
.field{position:relative;margin-bottom:12px}
.field>svg{position:absolute;left:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted);width:19px;height:19px;pointer-events:none;transition:color .25s}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;height:54px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#FAFCFF;border-radius:17px;padding:0 48px 0 46px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;outline:none;transition:border .25s,box-shadow .25s,background .25s}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--pri);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(14,165,233,.14);background:#fff}
.field:focus-within>svg{color:var(--pri)}
.field .eye{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
.field.plain input{padding-left:16px}
.row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.btn{width:100%;height:56px;border-radius:18px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),opacity .3s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn-pri{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 16px 30px -14px rgba(14,165,233,.95)}
.btn-soft{background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d)}
.btn-ghost{background:#EEF3F9;color:var(--ink2)}
.btn-rose{background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose)}
.btn-sm{height:42px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13.5px;width:auto;padding:0 16px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.65;pointer-events:none}
.spin{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-top-color:#fff;animation:rot .7s linear infinite}
.btn-soft .spin,.btn-ghost .spin{border-color:rgba(14,165,233,.25);border-top-color:var(--pri)}
.ripple{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);transform:scale(0);animation:rip .6s ease-out;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(4);opacity:0}}
.note{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.note svg{width:14px;height:14px}

/* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
#app{padding:0 18px 130px}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:20px 0 4px}
.avatar{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 46px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px -8px rgba(14,165,233,.9)}
.top .who{flex:1;min-width:0}
.top .who small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.top .who small svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.top .who b{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.icon-btn{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;transition:transform .2s;flex:0 0 44px}
.icon-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.icon-btn .dot{position:absolute;top:10px;right:11px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rose);border:2px solid #fff}
.icon-btn.spinning svg{animation:rot .8s linear infinite}
.live-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--rose);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px;cursor:pointer}
.live-pill i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:blink 1s infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.page-h{margin:14px 2px 16px}
.page-h small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.page-h small svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.page-h h2{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-top:3px}

/* ---------- RINGS HERO ---------- */
.rings-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:20px 18px}
.rings{position:relative;width:150px;height:150px;flex:0 0 150px}
.rings svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.rings .bg{fill:none;stroke-width:12;opacity:.14}
.rings .fg{fill:none;stroke-width:12;stroke-linecap:round;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.6s var(--ease)}
.rings .c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center}
.rings .c b{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;display:block;line-height:1}
.rings .c small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.legend{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.lg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.lg-row .ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 34px}
.lg-row .ic svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.lg-row .tx{min-width:0}
.lg-row .tx>span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;display:block}
.lg-row .tx b{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.lg-row .tx b small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.c-cyan{background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri)} .c-mint{background:var(--mint-l);color:var(--mint)}
.c-rose{background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose)} .c-blue{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue)}
.c-teal{background:var(--teal-l);color:var(--teal)} .c-navy{background:#E7ECF6;color:var(--navy)}

/* quick actions */
.quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.qa{border-radius:22px;padding:12px 4px 11px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.qa:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.qa .ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.qa.main .ic{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 20px -10px rgba(14,165,233,.9)}
.qa.main.on .ic{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FB7185,#F43F5E);animation:pulseR 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes pulseR{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(244,63,94,.5)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(244,63,94,0)}}

/* heart card */
.heart-card{margin-top:12px}
.hc-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.hc-top .hb{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose);display:grid;place-items:center}
.hc-top .hb svg{animation:hb var(--beat,.85s) ease-in-out infinite;fill:rgba(244,63,94,.2)}
@keyframes hb{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}18%{transform:scale(1.28)}36%{transform:scale(.94)}}
.hc-top .v{flex:1}
.hc-top .v>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.hc-top .v b{display:block;font-size:30px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.1}
.hc-top .v b small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-left:3px}
.src-tag{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:#EEF3F9;color:var(--ink2);margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.ecg{height:46px;margin:10px -18px 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative;-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent);mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent)}
.ecg svg{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:46px;width:800px;animation:ecg var(--ecg,3s) linear infinite}
@keyframes ecg{to{transform:translateX(-400px)}}
.ecg path{fill:none;stroke:var(--rose);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.hstats{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.hstats div{flex:1;background:#F6F8FC;border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px}
.hstats span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;display:block}
.hstats b{font-size:15px;font-weight:800}

.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.mini .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2)}
.mini .hd .ic{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.mini .hd .ic svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.mini .v{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:10px}
.mini .v small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-left:3px}
.mini .s{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
.drops{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:3px;margin-top:10px}
.drop{height:18px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/60% 60% 40% 40%;background:var(--blue-l);transition:background .4s,transform .4s var(--ease)}
.drop.on{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7DD3FC,var(--blue));transform:scale(1.06)}
.add-mini{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .2s}
.add-mini:active{transform:scale(.85)}
.add-mini svg{width:16px;height:16px}

/* RINA coach card */
.rina-card{margin-top:12px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#E0F7FF 0%,#D7F5EE 55%,#E6EEFF 100%);border:1px solid #fff;padding:18px 140px 18px 18px;min-height:168px;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.rina-card .m{position:absolute;right:-6px;bottom:-34px;width:150px;height:215px;animation:bob 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.rina-card .tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;color:var(--pri-d);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.rina-card .tag svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.rina-card h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin:10px 0 4px;line-height:1.3}
.rina-card p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.5}
.rina-card .btn{margin-top:12px;height:40px;width:auto;padding:0 16px;font-size:13px;border-radius:14px}

/* section head */
.sec-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:24px 2px 12px}
.sec-h h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.sec-h button{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.sec-h button svg{width:16px;height:16px}

/* routines with photos */
.hscroll{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;margin:0 -18px;padding:2px 18px 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
.hscroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rt{flex:0 0 172px;scroll-snap-align:start;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh2);position:relative;transition:transform .25s var(--ease);cursor:pointer}
.rt:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.rt-img{height:124px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.rt-img .fb{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rt-img .fb svg{width:38px;height:38px;opacity:.85}
.rt-img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--ease),filter .4s}
.rt:hover .rt-img img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.rt-img::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,30,61,0) 55%,rgba(15,30,61,.35))}
.rt.done .rt-img img{filter:saturate(.5) brightness(.95)}
.rt-check{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:2;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:grid;place-items:center;color:transparent;border:2px solid #fff;transition:all .35s var(--ease)}
.rt-check svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke-width:3}
.rt.done .rt-check{background:var(--mint);color:#fff;transform:scale(1.1)}
.rt .badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;z-index:2;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:99px}
.rt .dur{position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:9px;z-index:2;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.rt .dur svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.rt-body{padding:11px 13px 13px}
.rt-body b{font-size:14px;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.rt-body span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.rt.done .rt-body b{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--mint);text-decoration-thickness:2px;color:var(--muted)}
.rt-add{flex:0 0 118px;border:2px dashed #CBD7E6;border-radius:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.rt-add .p{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri);display:grid;place-items:center}
.t-walk{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#D1FAE5,#6EE7B7);color:#047857}
.t-run{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#FFE4EA,#FDA4AF);color:#BE123C}
.t-strength{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#DBEAFE,#93C5FD);color:#1D4ED8}
.t-stretch{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#CFFAFE,#67E8F9);color:#0E7490}
.t-yoga{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#CCFBF1,#5EEAD4);color:#0F766E}
.t-cycle{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#E0F2FE,#7DD3FC);color:#0369A1}
.t-swim{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#DBEAFE,#60A5FA);color:#1E40AF}
.t-hiit{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#FCE7F3,#F9A8D4);color:#BE185D}
.t-auto{background:var(--grad);color:#fff}

/* ---------- LIVE ---------- */
.sensors{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.sn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:#fff;color:var(--muted);box-shadow:var(--sh2);transition:all .3s}
.sn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.sn.ok{background:var(--mint-l);color:#047857}
.sn.warn{background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose)}
.modes{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;margin:0 -18px 14px;padding:2px 18px 6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.modes::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.mode{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 14px 9px 9px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);box-shadow:var(--sh2);border:2px solid transparent;transition:all .3s var(--ease)}
.mode .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.mode .ic svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.mode.on{border-color:var(--pri);color:var(--pri-d);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.live-main{text-align:center;padding:22px 18px 20px}
.lv-ring{position:relative;width:236px;height:236px;margin:0 auto}
.lv-ring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.lv-ring .bg{fill:none;stroke:#E6EEF7;stroke-width:14}
.lv-ring .fg{fill:none;stroke:url(#gCyan);stroke-width:14;stroke-linecap:round;transition:stroke-dashoffset .9s linear}
.lv-ring .core{position:absolute;inset:24px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#fff,#F4FAFF)}
.lv-ring.run .core{animation:glow 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes glow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(14,165,233,.25)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(14,165,233,0)}}
.lv-c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.lv-c .st{font-size:46px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lv-c small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.lv-c .tm{margin-top:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--pri-d);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.lv-c .tm svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.detect{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;background:#EEF3F9;color:var(--ink2);transition:all .4s var(--ease)}
.detect svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.detect.walk{background:var(--mint-l);color:#047857}
.detect.run{background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose)}
.detect.cycle{background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d)}
.lv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.lv-grid div{background:#F6F9FD;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 6px}
.lv-grid b{display:block;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lv-grid span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
.lv-grid span svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.wave{width:100%;height:56px;margin-top:12px;display:block}
.ctrls{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin-top:16px}
.round{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.round:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.round.main{width:82px;height:82px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 16px 32px -12px rgba(14,165,233,.95)}
.round.main.stop{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FB7185,#F43F5E);box-shadow:0 16px 32px -12px rgba(244,63,94,.9)}
.round.main svg{width:32px;height:32px}
.round.sec{background:#EEF3F9;color:var(--ink2)}
.syncline{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.syncline svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.how{margin-top:12px}
.fullban{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:14px;border-radius:22px;margin-bottom:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#E0F2FE,#DCFCE9);border:1px solid #fff;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.fullban .ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 44px}
.fullban b{font-size:14px;display:block}
.fullban p{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px}
.fullban a{margin-top:8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none}
.fullban a svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.sc-blk{border-radius:16px;padding:11px 13px;margin:8px 0;color:#fff;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.5;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.sc-blk>b{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:4px 7px;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.sc-blk>b svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.sc-blk code{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11.5px}
.sc-red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FB7185,#E11D48)}.sc-gray{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#64748B,#334155)}.sc-blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#38BDF8,#2563EB)}.sc-green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#34D399,#059669)}
.phase{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;margin:16px 0 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.phase span{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px}
.tip{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);background:#FFF8E6;border:1px solid #FDE7A9;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px}
.tip.cyan{background:var(--pri-l);border-color:#BAE6FD}
.how h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.how-item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.how-item:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.how-item .ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 38px}
.how-item .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.how-item b{font-size:13.5px}
.how-item p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:2px}
.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.li{border-radius:20px;padding:12px 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.li .ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 44px}
.li .tx{flex:1;min-width:0}
.li .tx b{font-size:14px;display:block}
.li .tx span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.li .r{font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--pri-d);text-align:right}
.li .r small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.li .del{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
.li .del:active{background:var(--rose-l);color:var(--rose)}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;padding:22px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}

/* ---------- STATS ---------- */
.chart{margin-top:12px}
.plot{position:relative;height:170px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
.goal-line{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;border-top:2px dashed rgba(14,165,233,.45)}
.goal-line span{position:absolute;left:0;top:-19px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--pri)}
.bar{flex:1;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
.bar .col{width:100%;max-width:32px;border-radius:12px 12px 8px 8px;background:#DCEBF7;height:0;transition:height 1.2s var(--ease);position:relative}
.bar.hit .col{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6EE7B7,#10B981)}
.bar.today .col{background:var(--grad)}
.bar .tip{position:absolute;top:-18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s .9s}
.chart.ready .tip{opacity:1}
.labels{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
.labels small{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.labels small.today{color:var(--pri)}
.hchart{width:100%;height:120px;margin-top:10px;display:block}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.tile .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.tile .v{font-size:23px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tile .l{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.chip svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.big{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600}

/* ---------- PROFILE ---------- */
.prof-hero{text-align:center;padding:24px 18px 20px}
.prof-hero .avatar{width:84px;height:84px;font-size:32px;margin:0 auto 12px;border:4px solid #fff}
.prof-hero h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:800}
.prof-hero p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.pstats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.pstats div{background:#F6F9FD;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 4px}
.pstats b{display:block;font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.pstats span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.lbl{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink2);margin:2px 2px 7px;display:block}
.slider-val{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:8px}
.slider-val b{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--pri-d)}
input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:8px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pri) var(--p,40%),#DCEBF7 var(--p,40%));outline:none}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:5px solid var(--pri);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(14,165,233,.5);cursor:pointer}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:5px solid var(--pri)}
.bmi{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:18px;background:#F6F9FD;margin:4px 0 14px}
.bmi b{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.bmi .tag{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:99px}
.keybox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#F6F9FD;border:1.5px dashed #BFD6EA;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 10px 10px 14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.keybox code{flex:1;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);word-break:break-all;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}
.keybox button{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--pri-d);flex:0 0 36px;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.steps-ol{counter-reset:s;list-style:none;margin:10px 0 4px}
.steps-ol li{counter-increment:s;position:relative;padding:0 0 12px 36px;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2)}
.steps-ol li::before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;display:grid;place-items:center}
pre.json{background:var(--navy);color:#A5F3FC;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:11.5px;overflow:auto;line-height:1.5;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}

/* ---------- NAV + RINA FAB ---------- */
.nav-wrap{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;padding:0 14px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));pointer-events:none}
.nav{max-width:432px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:30px;padding:7px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:auto;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -16px rgba(15,30,61,.35)}
.nav button{height:54px;min-width:54px;border-radius:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;transition:all .45s var(--ease);padding:0 14px;position:relative}
.nav button span{max-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;transition:max-width .45s var(--ease)}
.nav button.on{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;padding:0 20px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px -10px rgba(14,165,233,.95)}
.nav button.on span{max-width:90px}
.nav button .ldot{position:absolute;top:10px;right:12px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rose);animation:blink 1s infinite}
.nav svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.rina-fab{position:fixed;z-index:60;right:max(16px,calc(50% - 214px));bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;padding:3px;background:conic-gradient(#22D3EE,#0EA5E9,#34D399,#22D3EE);box-shadow:0 16px 30px -10px rgba(14,165,233,.7);animation:fabIn .8s 1s var(--ease) both,wig 6s 3s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform .2s}
.rina-fab:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.rina-fab .face{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background-color:#fff;border:3px solid #fff}
.rina-fab .ai{position:absolute;top:-4px;left:-6px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:99px;border:2px solid #fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.rina-fab .ai svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.rina-tip{position:absolute;right:74px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:#fff;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:16px 16px 4px 16px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:var(--sh);animation:tipIn .6s 2s var(--ease) both,tipOut .5s 8s forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes tipIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(10px,-50%) scale(.8)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,-50%)}}
@keyframes tipOut{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
@keyframes fabIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.3) rotate(-30deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes wig{0%,92%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}94%{transform:rotate(-12deg)}96%{transform:rotate(10deg)}98%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}}

/* ---------- SHEET ---------- */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(11,19,36,.36);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:80;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:all .35s}
.overlay.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.sheet{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:90;max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border-radius:30px 30px 0 0;padding:12px 20px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateY(105%);transition:transform .5s var(--ease);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto}
.sheet.show{transform:none}
.sheet.full{height:92vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-bottom:0;overflow:hidden}
.grab{width:44px;height:5px;border-radius:9px;background:#DCE4EE;margin:0 auto 14px;flex:0 0 auto}
.sheet h4{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
.sheet .desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.5}
.qchips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:-4px 0 14px}
.qchips button{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d);font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px}
.opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;border-radius:20px;background:#F6F9FD;margin-bottom:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:2px solid transparent;transition:all .25s}
.opt:active{border-color:var(--pri)}
.opt .ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 48px}
.opt b{font-size:14.5px;display:block}
.opt span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;display:block}
.sel-types{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:14px;scrollbar-width:none}
.sel-types button{flex:0 0 auto;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:14px;background:#F1F5FA;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--ink2);border:2px solid transparent}
.sel-types button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.sel-types button.on{border-color:var(--pri);background:var(--pri-l);color:var(--pri-d)}
/* PPG */
.ppg{text-align:center}
.ppg-ring{position:relative;width:200px;height:200px;margin:6px auto 10px}
.ppg-ring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.ppg-ring .bg{fill:none;stroke:var(--rose-l);stroke-width:12}
.ppg-ring .fg{fill:none;stroke:var(--rose);stroke-width:12;stroke-linecap:round;transition:stroke-dashoffset .3s linear}
.ppg-ring .c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ppg-ring .c svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--rose);transform:none;animation:hb .85s infinite;fill:rgba(244,63,94,.2)}
.ppg-ring .c b{font-size:42px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1}
.ppg-ring .c small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
#ppgWave{width:100%;height:70px;display:block;background:#FFF5F7;border-radius:16px}
.ppg-st{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);margin:10px 0 14px;min-height:20px}
/* chat */
.chat-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:0 0 auto}
.chat-head .av{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background-color:#E0F4FD;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:var(--sh2);flex:0 0 50px}
.chat-head b{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;display:block}
.chat-head span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mint);font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.chat-head span i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);animation:blink 1.4s infinite}
.chat-head .x{margin-left:auto;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;background:#F1F5FA;display:grid;place-items:center}
.msgs{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px 2px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.msg{max-width:84%;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;animation:msgIn .4s var(--ease) both;word-wrap:break-word}
@keyframes msgIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.msg.u{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:6px}
.msg.r{align-self:flex-start;background:#F1F6FB;color:var(--ink);border-bottom-left-radius:6px}
.msg.r em{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.mrow{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end}
.mrow .av{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background-color:#E0F4FD;flex:0 0 30px}
.typing{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:14px 16px}
.typing i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pri);animation:tdot 1s infinite}
.typing i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.typing i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes tdot{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.4}30%{transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:1}}
.sugg{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0;flex:0 0 auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.sugg button{flex:0 0 auto;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2)}
.composer{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end;padding:8px 0 calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));flex:0 0 auto}
.composer textarea{flex:1;min-height:50px;max-height:120px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:13px 16px;font-size:14.5px;resize:none;outline:none;background:#FAFCFF}
.composer textarea:focus{border-color:var(--pri)}
.composer button{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 50px;box-shadow:0 10px 20px -10px rgba(14,165,233,.9)}

/* toast */
.toasts{position:fixed;top:14px;left:0;right:0;z-index:300;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;pointer-events:none;padding:0 16px}
.toast{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;box-shadow:0 16px 36px -12px rgba(15,30,61,.35);animation:tIn .5s var(--ease) both;max-width:420px}
.toast.out{animation:tOut .4s var(--ease) forwards}
.toast .ic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 30px}
.toast .ic svg{width:17px;height:17px}
@keyframes tIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px) scale(.95)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes tOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-16px) scale(.95)}}
.confetti{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:250;overflow:hidden}
.confetti i{position:absolute;top:-12px;width:9px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;animation:fall linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(105vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:.2}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="mesh"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><defs>
  <linearGradient id="gCyan" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#22D3EE"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#0EA5E9"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2563EB"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="gMint" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#6EE7B7"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#059669"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="gRose" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#FDA4AF"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#E11D48"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="gArea" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#F43F5E" stop-opacity=".28"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#F43F5E" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>
</defs></svg>

<!-- PRELOADER -->
<div id="loader">
  <div class="ld-ring"><div class="ld-face rina-head"></div></div>
  <svg class="ld-ecg" viewBox="0 0 180 36"><path d="M2 20 H50 L58 8 L66 30 L76 2 L86 28 L92 20 H178"/></svg>
  <div class="ld-brand">VITA <b>×</b> RINA</div>
  <div class="ld-tip" id="ldTip">RINA sedang menyiapkan dashboard…</div>
</div>
<div class="toasts" id="toasts"></div>

<div class="shell">
  <!-- ============ AUTH ============ -->
  <section id="auth" class="hidden">
    <div class="screen">
      <div class="brand"><div class="lg"><i data-lucide="activity"></i></div><div>VITA × RINA<small>Smart Fitness • AMM</small></div></div>
      <div class="hero">
        <div class="halo"></div>
        <div class="bubble">Hai! Aku RINA, coach kebugaranmu 👋</div>
        <div class="mascot rina-full"></div>
        <div class="fchip glass" style="left:0;top:96px"><span class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i></span><div><small>Detak</small>72 bpm</div></div>
        <div class="fchip glass" style="right:0;top:130px;animation-delay:-1.2s"><span class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="footprints"></i></span><div><small>Langkah</small>8.432</div></div>
        <div class="fchip glass" style="left:8px;bottom:22px;animation-delay:-2.2s"><span class="ic c-mint"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></span><div><small>Live</small>Realtime</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="auth-title"><h1>Bugar di site,<br><em>aman bekerja.</em></h1><p>Langkah, jarak & detak jantung terpantau realtime — dibantu RINA AI.</p></div>
      <div class="auth-card glass">
        <div class="seg" id="seg"><div class="pill"></div><button class="on" data-tab="login">Masuk</button><button data-tab="reg">Daftar</button></div>
        <form id="fLogin" autocomplete="on">
          <div class="field"><i data-lucide="mail"></i><input type="email" id="lEmail" placeholder="Email" required autocomplete="email"></div>
          <div class="field"><i data-lucide="lock"></i><input type="password" id="lPass" placeholder="Password" required autocomplete="current-password"><button type="button" class="eye" data-eye="lPass"><i data-lucide="eye"></i></button></div>
          <button class="btn btn-pri" type="submit">Masuk <i data-lucide="arrow-right"></i></button>
        </form>
        <form id="fReg" class="hidden" autocomplete="on">
          <div class="field"><i data-lucide="user-round"></i><input id="rName" placeholder="Nama lengkap" required autocomplete="name"></div>
          <div class="field"><i data-lucide="mail"></i><input type="email" id="rEmail" placeholder="Email" required autocomplete="email"></div>
          <div class="field"><i data-lucide="lock"></i><input type="password" id="rPass" placeholder="Password (min. 6 karakter)" required minlength="6" autocomplete="new-password"><button type="button" class="eye" data-eye="rPass"><i data-lucide="eye"></i></button></div>
          <div class="row2">
            <div class="field"><i data-lucide="scale"></i><input type="number" id="rW" placeholder="Berat (kg)"></div>
            <div class="field"><i data-lucide="ruler"></i><input type="number" id="rH" placeholder="Tinggi (cm)"></div>
          </div>
          <button class="btn btn-pri" type="submit">Buat Akun <i data-lucide="sparkles"></i></button>
        </form>
        <div class="note"><i data-lucide="shield-check"></i>Password dienkripsi SHA-256 & tersimpan aman</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ APP ============ -->
  <section id="app" class="hidden">
    <div class="top">
      <div class="avatar" id="avTop">R</div>
      <div class="who"><small id="topSmall"></small><b id="topName"></b></div>
      <span class="live-pill hidden" id="livePill"><i></i>LIVE</span>
      <button class="icon-btn glass" id="btnRefresh" title="Muat ulang"><i data-lucide="refresh-cw"></i></button>
      <button class="icon-btn glass" id="btnBell" title="Notifikasi"><i data-lucide="bell"></i><span class="dot" id="bellDot"></span></button>

  </section>
</div>

<button class="rina-fab hidden" id="rinaFab" title="Tanya RINA AI"><div class="face rina-head"></div><span class="ai"><i data-lucide="sparkles"></i>AI</span><span class="rina-tip">Butuh saran? Tanya aku! ✨</span></button>

<div class="nav-wrap hidden" id="navWrap">
  <nav class="nav glass" id="nav">
    <button data-p="home" class="on"><i data-lucide="home"></i><span>Home</span></button>
    <button data-p="live"><i data-lucide="radio"></i><span>Live</span></button>
    <button data-p="stats"><i data-lucide="bar-chart-3"></i><span>Statistik</span></button>
    <button data-p="profile"><i data-lucide="user"></i><span>Profil</span></button>
  </nav>

<div class="overlay" id="overlay"></div>
