<video id="ppgV" playsinline muted style="position:fixed;width:2px;height:2px;opacity:.01;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none"></video>

<script>
/* ==================================================================
   KONFIGURASI
   API_URL hanya diisi jika index.html di-hosting di luar Apps Script
   (mis. GitHub Pages). Isi dengan URL web app (/exec).
   ================================================================== */
const API_URL = '';   // opsional — biasanya terisi otomatis lewat tombol "Buka VITA Full"
const GOAL_MIN = 30, GOAL_KCAL = 400;

/* ============================ API BRIDGE ============================ */
const store={get(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return null}},set(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}},del(k){try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}}};
const HAS_GAS = typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run;
const RUN_API = (()=>{
  if(API_URL) return API_URL;
  const m=location.hash.match(/api=([^&]+)/);
  if(m){const u=decodeURIComponent(m[1]);store.set('vita_api',u);try{history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search)}catch(e){}return u}
  return store.get('vita_api')||'';
})();
const IS_FULL = !HAS_GAS && !!RUN_API;           // versi penuh (GitHub Pages) → sensor & kamera bebas
const IS_IOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent)||(navigator.platform==='MacIntel'&&navigator.maxTouchPoints>1);
function api(fn, ...args){
  if(HAS_GAS) return new Promise((res,rej)=>google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej)[fn](...args));
  if(RUN_API) return fetch(RUN_API,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},body:JSON.stringify({action:fn,args})}).then(r=>r.json());
  return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(MOCK[fn](...args)),350));
}

/* ------------- MOCK: hanya untuk preview di luar Apps Script ------------- */
const MOCK=(()=>{
  const K='vita2_mock', KC={walk:4,run:10,strength:6,yoga:3,cycle:8,stretch:2.5,swim:9,hiit:11};
  const E={users:{},act:{},rt:{},log:{},wo:{},hr:{}};
  const db=()=>{try{return Object.assign({},E,JSON.parse(store.get(K))||{})}catch(e){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(E))}};
  const save=d=>store.set(K,JSON.stringify(d));
  const dk=d=>{const x=d||new Date();return x.getFullYear()+'-'+String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')};
  const hm=()=>new Date().toTimeString().slice(0,5);
  const who=(d,t)=>Object.values(d.users).find(u=>u.token&&u.token===t);
  const tok=()=>Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Date.now().toString(36);
  const dash=(d,u)=>{const e=u.email,td=dk(),A=d.act[e]||{},t=A[td]||{steps:0,kcal:0,minutes:0,heart:0,water:0,distance:0};
    const done=(d.log[e]||{})[td]||[];const rts=(d.rt[e]||[]).filter(r=>r.active).map(r=>({...r,done:done.includes(r.id)})).sort((a,b)=>a.time.localeCompare(b.time));
    let rm=0,rk=0;rts.forEach(r=>{if(r.done){rm+=r.duration;rk+=Math.round(r.duration*(KC[r.type]||4))}});
    const days=['Min','Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab'],week=[];
    for(let i=6;i>=0;i--){const dd=new Date(Date.now()-i*864e5),r=A[dk(dd)]||{};week.push({date:dk(dd),label:days[dd.getDay()],steps:r.steps||0,kcal:r.kcal||0,minutes:r.minutes||0,distance:r.distance||0,today:i===0})}
    let streak=0;for(let i=0;i<365;i++){const s=(A[dk(new Date(Date.now()-i*864e5))]||{}).steps||0;if(s>=u.goal)streak++;else if(i===0)continue;else break}
    const H=(d.hr[e]||[]).filter(h=>h.d===td),b=H.map(h=>h.bpm);
    const today={steps:t.steps,kcal:t.kcal+rk,minutes:t.minutes+rm,heart:t.heart||((d.hr[e]||[]).slice(-1)[0]||{}).bpm||0,water:t.water,distance:t.distance||0};
    week[6].kcal=today.kcal;week[6].minutes=today.minutes;
    return{ok:true,user:{email:e,name:u.name,goal:u.goal,weight:u.weight,height:u.height,createdAt:u.createdAt},today,routines:rts,week,streak,
      recentWorkouts:(d.wo[e]||[]).slice(-6).reverse(),heartToday:H.map(h=>({t:h.t,bpm:h.bpm,src:h.src})),
      heartStats:b.length?{min:Math.min(...b),max:Math.max(...b),avg:Math.round(b.reduce((a,c)=>a+c,0)/b.length)}:null,
      totalSteps:Object.values(A).reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.steps||0),0),totalWorkouts:(d.wo[e]||[]).length,serverDate:td}};
  const up=(d,u,p)=>{const e=u.email,td=dk();d.act[e]=d.act[e]||{};const t=d.act[e][td]||{steps:0,kcal:0,minutes:0,heart:0,water:0,distance:0};
    const st=+p.steps||0;let kc=+p.kcal||0;if(!kc&&st)kc=Math.round(st*.04*((u.weight||70)/70));
    t.steps+=st;t.kcal+=kc;t.minutes+=Math.round(+p.minutes||0);t.distance=(t.distance||0)+Math.round(+p.distance||0);if(+p.heart>0)t.heart=+p.heart;t.water=Math.max(0,t.water+(+p.water||0));d.act[e][td]=t};
  const hr=(d,u,b,s)=>{if(+b>=30){(d.hr[u.email]=d.hr[u.email]||[]).push({d:dk(),t:hm(),bpm:+b,src:s||'manual'})}};
  const W=(t,f)=>{const d=db(),u=who(d,t);if(!u)return{ok:false,msg:'SESSION_EXPIRED'};const r=f(d,u);save(d);return r||dash(d,u)};
  return{
    register(p){const d=db(),e=(p.email||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      if((p.name||'').trim().length<2)return{ok:false,msg:'Nama minimal 2 karakter'};if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(e))return{ok:false,msg:'Format email tidak valid'};
      if((p.password||'').length<6)return{ok:false,msg:'Password minimal 6 karakter'};if(d.users[e])return{ok:false,msg:'Email sudah terdaftar, silakan login'};
      d.users[e]={email:e,name:p.name.trim(),pw:p.password,goal:10000,weight:+p.weight||0,height:+p.height||0,key:tok().toUpperCase().slice(0,20),createdAt:new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'})};
      d.rt[e]=[['Morning stretch','07:00',10,'stretch'],['Lunchtime walk','12:30',20,'walk'],['Leg workout','18:00',45,'strength']].map(x=>({id:tok().slice(0,8),name:x[0],time:x[1],duration:x[2],type:x[3],active:true}));
      save(d);return this.login(p)},
    login(p){const d=db(),u=d.users[(p.email||'').trim().toLowerCase()];if(!u)return{ok:false,msg:'Akun tidak ditemukan, silakan daftar dulu'};if(u.pw!==p.password)return{ok:false,msg:'Password salah'};u.token=tok();save(d);return{ok:true,token:u.token,user:u}},
    logout(t){const d=db(),u=who(d,t);if(u){u.token='';save(d)}return{ok:true}},
    getDashboard(t){const d=db(),u=who(d,t);return u?dash(d,u):{ok:false,msg:'SESSION_EXPIRED'}},
    saveActivity(t,p){return W(t,(d,u)=>{up(d,u,p);if(+p.heart>0)hr(d,u,p.heart,'manual')})},
    logHeart(t,b,s){return W(t,(d,u)=>{hr(d,u,b,s);up(d,u,{heart:b})})},
    liveSync(t,p){const r=W(t,(d,u)=>{up(d,u,p);if(+p.heart>0)hr(d,u,p.heart,'live')});return r.ok?{ok:true,today:r.today,syncedAt:new Date().toTimeString().slice(0,8)}:r},
    finishSession(t,s){return W(t,(d,u)=>{if(s.delta)up(d,u,s.delta);(d.wo[u.email]=d.wo[u.email]||[]).push({date:dk(),type:s.type,minutes:Math.max(1,Math.round(s.minutes)),kcal:Math.round(s.kcal),steps:s.steps,distance:Math.round(s.distance),avgHR:s.avgHR,source:'live'})})},
    toggleRoutine(t,id){return W(t,(d,u)=>{const td=dk();d.log[u.email]=d.log[u.email]||{};const L=d.log[u.email][td]=d.log[u.email][td]||[];const i=L.indexOf(id);i>-1?L.splice(i,1):L.push(id)})},
    addRoutine(t,p){if(!(p.name||'').trim())return{ok:false,msg:'Nama rutinitas wajib diisi'};return W(t,(d,u)=>{d.rt[u.email].push({id:tok().slice(0,8),name:p.name.trim(),time:p.time||'08:00',duration:+p.duration||10,type:p.type||'walk',active:true})})},
    deleteRoutine(t,id){return W(t,(d,u)=>{const r=d.rt[u.email].find(x=>x.id===id);if(r)r.active=false})},
    updateProfile(t,p){return W(t,(d,u)=>{u.name=(p.name||'').trim()||u.name;u.goal=Math.min(50000,Math.max(1000,+p.goal||u.goal));u.weight=+p.weight||0;u.height=+p.height||0})},
    changePassword(t,p){const d=db(),u=who(d,t);if(!u)return{ok:false,msg:'SESSION_EXPIRED'};if(u.pw!==p.oldPassword)return{ok:false,msg:'Password lama salah'};if((p.newPassword||'').length<6)return{ok:false,msg:'Password baru minimal 6 karakter'};u.pw=p.newPassword;save(d);return{ok:true,msg:'Password berhasil diganti'}},
    getSyncInfo(t){const d=db(),u=who(d,t);return u?{ok:true,key:u.key||'DEMO-KEY',url:'https://script.google.com/macros/s/XXXX/exec',fullUrl:''}:{ok:false,msg:'SESSION_EXPIRED'}},
    resetSyncKey(t){const d=db(),u=who(d,t);u.key=tok().toUpperCase().slice(0,20);save(d);return{ok:true,key:u.key,url:'https://script.google.com/macros/s/XXXX/exec'}},
    askRina(t,m){const r=this.getDashboard(t);if(!r.ok)return r;const n=r.user.name.split(' ')[0],td=r.today,left=Math.max(0,r.user.goal-td.steps);
      return{ok:true,reply:`Halo ${n}! 👋 Hari ini kamu sudah **${td.steps.toLocaleString('id-ID')} langkah**, ${td.kcal} kcal, ${td.minutes} menit aktif.\n• ${left?`Sisa ${left.toLocaleString('id-ID')} langkah ≈ ${Math.ceil(left/100)} menit jalan santai.`:'Target langkah tercapai! 🏆'}\n• Jangan lupa minum air (${td.water}/8 gelas) 💧\n\n_(Preview offline — di Apps Script RINA memakai Gemini AI)_`}}
  };
})();

/* ============================ STATE & UTIL ============================ */
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const S={token:store.get('vita_token'),data:null,page:'home',sync:null,chat:[]};
const IMG=(id,q)=>`https://images.unsplash.com/photo-${id}?auto=format&fit=crop&w=480&q=70${q||''}`;
const TYPES={
  walk:{n:'Jalan',i:'footprints',img:IMG('1477332552946-cfb384aeaf1c')},
  run:{n:'Lari',i:'zap',img:IMG('1758966071975-b58c681f05e0')},
  strength:{n:'Kekuatan',i:'dumbbell',img:IMG('1641337221253-fdc7237f6b61')},
  stretch:{n:'Stretching',i:'person-standing',img:IMG('1701826510650-c505cf56e2bf')},
  yoga:{n:'Yoga',i:'flower-2',img:IMG('1764111585854-e447928a6eeb')},
  cycle:{n:'Sepeda',i:'bike',img:IMG('1763041821558-71301407ded8')},
  swim:{n:'Renang',i:'waves',img:'https://images.pexels.com/photos/9030298/pexels-photo-9030298.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=480'},
  hiit:{n:'HIIT',i:'flame',img:IMG('1589579234096-25cb6b83e021')}
};
const KCAL_MIN={walk:4,run:10,strength:6,yoga:3,cycle:8,stretch:2.5,swim:9,hiit:11,idle:0};
const fmtN=n=>Math.round(n||0).toLocaleString('id-ID');
const fmtKm=m=>((m||0)/1000).toFixed(2).replace('.',',');
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const icons=()=>window.lucide&&lucide.createIcons();
const greet=()=>{const h=new Date().getHours();return h<11?'Selamat pagi':h<15?'Selamat siang':h<18?'Selamat sore':'Selamat malam'};
const first=n=>String(n||'').split(' ')[0];
const wkg=()=>((S.data&&S.data.user.weight)||70)/70;

function toast(msg,type='ok'){
  const m={ok:['check','c-mint'],err:['alert-circle','c-rose'],info:['sparkles','c-cyan']}[type]||['check','c-mint'];
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='toast';
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="ic ${m[1]}"><i data-lucide="${m[0]}"></i></div><div>${esc(msg)}</div>`;
  $('#toasts').appendChild(el);icons();setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.add('out');setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),400)},3000);
}
function confetti(){
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='confetti';const cols=['#22D3EE','#0EA5E9','#2563EB','#10B981','#34D399','#F43F5E'];
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++){const c=document.createElement('i');c.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';c.style.background=cols[i%cols.length];c.style.animationDuration=(1.8+Math.random()*1.6)+'s';c.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*.4)+'s';box.appendChild(c)}
  document.body.appendChild(box);setTimeout(()=>box.remove(),3800);
}
function countUp(root){
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el=>{
    const end=+el.dataset.count,dec=+(el.dataset.dec||0),t0=performance.now();
    const st=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1300),v=end*(1-Math.pow(1-p,4));el.textContent=dec?v.toFixed(dec).replace('.',','):fmtN(v);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(st)};
    requestAnimationFrame(st);
  });
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('.btn,.round.main');if(!b)return;
  const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(),s=Math.max(r.width,r.height),sp=document.createElement('span');
  sp.className='ripple';sp.style.cssText=`width:${s}px;height:${s}px;left:${e.clientX-r.left-s/2}px;top:${e.clientY-r.top-s/2}px`;b.appendChild(sp);setTimeout(()=>sp.remove(),600);
});
function busy(b,on){if(!b)return;if(on){b.dataset.html=b.innerHTML;b.innerHTML='<div class="spin"></div>';b.disabled=true}else{b.innerHTML=b.dataset.html||b.innerHTML;b.disabled=false;icons()}}
async function run(fn,args=[],btn,quiet){
  busy(btn,true);
  try{
    const r=await api(fn,...args);
    if(!r||!r.ok){
      if(r&&r.msg==='SESSION_EXPIRED'){toast('Sesi berakhir, silakan login lagi','err');doLogout(true);return null}
      if(!quiet)toast((r&&r.msg)||'Terjadi kesalahan','err');return null;
    }
    return r;
  }catch(e){if(!quiet)toast('Gagal terhubung: '+(e.message||e),'err');return null}
  finally{busy(btn,false)}
}

/* =============================== BOOT =============================== */
const tips=['RINA sedang menyiapkan dashboard…','Menyalakan sensor gerak…','Mengukur semangatmu hari ini…','Siap bergerak!'];
let tipI=0;const tipIv=setInterval(()=>{const el=$('#ldTip');el.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>{el.textContent=tips[++tipI%tips.length];el.style.opacity=1},300)},900);
(async function boot(){
  icons();
  const wait=new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800));let ok=false;
  if(S.token){try{const r=await api('getDashboard',S.token);if(r&&r.ok){S.data=r;ok=true}else store.del('vita_token')}catch(e){}}
  await wait;clearInterval(tipIv);$('#loader').classList.add('out');
  ok?showApp():showAuth();
})();

/* =============================== AUTH =============================== */
function showAuth(){
  ['#app','#navWrap','#rinaFab'].forEach(s=>$(s).classList.add('hidden'));
  $('#auth').classList.remove('hidden');icons();
}
$('#seg').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;const reg=b.dataset.tab==='reg';
  $('#seg').classList.toggle('reg',reg);$$('#seg button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));
  $('#fLogin').classList.toggle('hidden',reg);$('#fReg').classList.toggle('hidden',!reg);
});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('[data-eye]');if(!b)return;const i=document.getElementById(b.dataset.eye),sh=i.type==='password';
  i.type=sh?'text':'password';b.innerHTML=`<i data-lucide="${sh?'eye-off':'eye'}"></i>`;icons();
});
$('#fLogin').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();const r=await run('login',[{email:$('#lEmail').value,password:$('#lPass').value}],$('#fLogin .btn'));
  if(r)afterAuth(r,'Selamat datang kembali');
});
$('#fReg').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=await run('register',[{name:$('#rName').value,email:$('#rEmail').value,password:$('#rPass').value,weight:$('#rW').value,height:$('#rH').value}],$('#fReg .btn'));
  if(r){afterAuth(r,'Akun berhasil dibuat');setTimeout(confetti,500)}
});
async function afterAuth(r,msg){
  S.token=r.token;store.set('vita_token',r.token);
  const d=await run('getDashboard',[S.token]);if(!d)return;
  S.data=d;toast(`${msg}, ${first(d.user.name)}! 👋`);showApp();
}
function doLogout(silent){
  if(L.on)stopLive(false);
  if(!silent&&S.token)api('logout',S.token).catch(()=>{});
  store.del('vita_token');S.token=null;S.data=null;S.sync=null;S.chat=[];$('#lPass').value='';showAuth();
}

/* ============================== APP SHELL ============================== */
function showApp(){
  $('#auth').classList.add('hidden');
  ['#app','#navWrap','#rinaFab'].forEach(s=>$(s).classList.remove('hidden'));
  try{S.chat=JSON.parse(store.get('vita_chat_'+S.data.user.email))||[]}catch(e){S.chat=[]}
  go(S.page||'home',true);
  if(!S.sync)api('getSyncInfo',S.token).then(r=>{if(r&&r.ok){S.sync=r;if(S.page==='live')render()}}).catch(()=>{});
}
$('#nav').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b)go(b.dataset.p)});
function go(p,force){
  if(p===S.page&&!force)return;S.page=p;
  $$('#nav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.p===p));
  render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
function header(){
  const d=S.data;
  $('#avTop').textContent=(d.user.name||'?').trim()[0].toUpperCase();
  $('#topSmall').innerHTML=`<i data-lucide="sun"></i>${new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'short'})}`;
  $('#topName').textContent=`${greet()}, ${first(d.user.name)}`;
  $('#bellDot').classList.toggle('hidden',d.today.steps>=d.user.goal);
  $('#livePill').classList.toggle('hidden',!L.on);
  const lb=$('#nav [data-p=live]');lb.querySelector('.ldot')?.remove();if(L.on)lb.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<i class="ldot"></i>');
}
function render(){
  if(!S.data)return;header();
  const P={home:pHome,live:pLive,stats:pStats,profile:pProfile}[S.page];
  $('#pages').innerHTML=`<div class="screen">${P(S.data)}</div>`;
  icons();countUp($('#pages'));
  $$('#pages .anim').forEach((el,i)=>el.style.animationDelay=(i*65)+'ms');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
    $$('[data-ring]').forEach(c=>c.style.strokeDashoffset=c.dataset.ring);
    $$('[data-h]').forEach(b=>b.style.height=b.dataset.h+'%');
    const ch=$('.chart');if(ch)ch.classList.add('ready');
    bindPage();if(S.page==='live')liveUI();if(S.page==='profile')loadSync();
  }));
}
function apply(r,msg){if(!r)return;S.data=r;render();if(msg)toast(msg)}
$('#livePill').addEventListener('click',()=>go('live'));
$('#btnRefresh').addEventListener('click',async e=>{
  const b=e.currentTarget;b.classList.add('spinning');const r=await run('getDashboard',[S.token]);b.classList.remove('spinning');
  if(r){S.data=r;render();toast('Data diperbarui','info')}
});
$('#btnBell').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const d=S.data,t=liveToday(),left=d.user.goal-t.steps,nx=d.routines.find(r=>!r.done);
  toast(left>0?`Tinggal ${fmtN(left)} langkah lagi menuju target 🎯`:'Target langkah hari ini tercapai! 🏆',left>0?'info':'ok');
  if(t.water<8)setTimeout(()=>toast(`Minum air baru ${t.water}/8 gelas 💧`,'info'),700);
  if(nx)setTimeout(()=>toast(`Berikutnya: ${nx.name} pukul ${nx.time}`,'info'),1400);
});

/* ================================ HOME ================================ */
function liveToday(){
  const t=Object.assign({},S.data.today);
  if(L.on){t.steps+=L.pend.steps;t.kcal+=Math.round(L.pend.kcal);t.minutes+=Math.floor(L.pend.sec/60);t.distance=(t.distance||0)+L.pend.dist;if(HR.bpm)t.heart=HR.bpm}
  else if(HR.bpm&&HR.live)t.heart=HR.bpm;
  return t;
}
function ringsSVG(t,g){
  const R=[[66,'gCyan',t.steps/g],[51,'gMint',t.minutes/GOAL_MIN],[36,'gRose',t.kcal/GOAL_KCAL]];
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 150 150">${R.map(([r,gr,p],i)=>{const C=2*Math.PI*r,o=C*(1-Math.min(1,p||0));
    return `<circle class="bg" cx="75" cy="75" r="${r}" stroke="url(#${gr})"/><circle class="fg" id="rg${i}" cx="75" cy="75" r="${r}" stroke="url(#${gr})" stroke-dasharray="${C}" stroke-dashoffset="${C}" data-ring="${o}"/>`}).join('')}</svg>`;
}
function routineCard(r,next){
  const t=TYPES[r.type]||TYPES.walk;
  return `<div class="rt ${r.done?'done':''}" data-rt="${esc(r.id)}">
    <div class="rt-img t-${esc(r.type)}"><div class="fb"><i data-lucide="${t.i}"></i></div>
      <img src="${t.img}" alt="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.remove()">
      ${next?'<span class="badge">Up next</span>':''}<div class="rt-check"><i data-lucide="check"></i></div>
      <span class="dur"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>${r.duration} min</span></div>
    <div class="rt-body"><b>${esc(r.name)}</b><span>${esc(r.time)} · ${t.n}</span></div></div>`;
}
function rinaLine(d,t){
  const pct=t.steps/d.user.goal,h=new Date().getHours(),n=first(d.user.name);
  if(L.on)return['Live tracking aktif 🔴',`Mantap ${n}! Tetap jaga ritme & napas. Aku pantau langkahmu realtime.`];
  if(pct>=1)return['Target tercapai! 🏆',`Keren ${n}, ${fmtN(t.steps)} langkah hari ini. Jangan lupa stretching & istirahat cukup sebelum shift.`];
  if(t.water<3&&h>=10)return['Sudah minum belum? 💧',`Baru ${t.water} gelas. Di area kerja panas, dehidrasi bikin cepat lelah & kurang fokus.`];
  if(pct>=.6)return['Sedikit lagi! ⚡',`Kurang ${fmtN(d.user.goal-t.steps)} langkah ≈ ${Math.ceil((d.user.goal-t.steps)/100)} menit jalan santai.`];
  return[`${greet()}, ${n}!`,'Yuk mulai Live tracking — langkah & jarakmu terhitung otomatis dari sensor HP.'];
}
function pHome(d){
  const t=liveToday(),g=d.user.goal,bpm=t.heart||0,nIdx=d.routines.findIndex(r=>!r.done),dn=d.routines.filter(r=>r.done).length,rl=rinaLine(d,t);
  const ecg='M0 26 H40 L46 18 L52 26 H70 L76 32 L82 4 L89 40 L95 26 H130 L136 21 L142 26 H200 L206 18 L212 26 H230 L236 32 L242 4 L249 40 L255 26 H290 L296 21 L302 26 H400';
  const hs=d.heartStats;
  return `
  <div class="card glass rings-card anim">
    <div class="rings">${ringsSVG(t,g)}<div class="c"><div><b id="hPct">${Math.round(Math.min(999,t.steps/g*100))}%</b><small>target</small></div></div></div>
    <div class="legend">
      <div class="lg-row"><span class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="footprints"></i></span><div class="tx"><span>Langkah</span><b><span id="hSteps" data-count="${t.steps}">0</span> <small>/ ${fmtN(g)}</small></b></div></div>
      <div class="lg-row"><span class="ic c-mint"><i data-lucide="timer"></i></span><div class="tx"><span>Menit aktif</span><b><span id="hMin">${fmtN(t.minutes)}</span> <small>/ ${GOAL_MIN} mnt</small></b></div></div>
      <div class="lg-row"><span class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="flame"></i></span><div class="tx"><span>Kalori</span><b><span id="hKcal">${fmtN(t.kcal)}</span> <small>kcal</small></b></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quick">
    <button class="qa glass main ${L.on?'on':''} anim" data-go="live"><span class="ic"><i data-lucide="${L.on?'radio':'play'}"></i></span>${L.on?'Live aktif':'Mulai Live'}</button>
    <button class="qa glass anim" id="qHeart"><span class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i></span>Ukur Jantung</button>
    <button class="qa glass anim" id="qManual"><span class="ic c-blue"><i data-lucide="pencil"></i></span>Catat</button>
    <button class="qa glass anim" id="qWater"><span class="ic c-teal"><i data-lucide="droplets"></i></span>+ Air</button>
  </div>

  <div class="card glass heart-card anim">
    <div class="hc-top">
      <div class="hb" style="--beat:${bpm?(60/bpm).toFixed(2):'.9'}s"><i data-lucide="heart"></i></div>
      <div class="v"><span>Detak jantung ${HR.src?`<span class="src-tag">${esc(HR.src)}</span>`:''}</span><b><span id="hBpm">${bpm||'--'}</span><small>bpm</small></b></div>
      <button class="btn btn-rose btn-sm" id="hMeasure"><i data-lucide="activity"></i>Ukur</button>
    </div>
    <div class="ecg" style="--ecg:${bpm?Math.max(1.4,Math.min(4.5,240/bpm)).toFixed(2):3}s"><svg viewBox="0 0 800 46" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="${ecg}"/><path d="${ecg}" transform="translate(400 0)"/></svg></div>
    <div class="hstats"><div><span>Min</span><b>${hs?hs.min:'--'}</b></div><div><span>Rata-rata</span><b>${hs?hs.avg:'--'}</b></div><div><span>Maks</span><b>${hs?hs.max:'--'}</b></div><div><span>Data</span><b>${d.heartToday.length}</b></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="duo">
    <div class="card glass mini anim"><div class="hd">Jarak<span class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="map-pin"></i></span></div>
      <div class="v"><span id="hDist">${fmtKm(t.distance)}</span><small>km</small></div><div class="s">${d.streak} hari streak 🔥</div></div>
    <div class="card glass mini anim"><div class="hd">Air minum<button class="add-mini" id="addWater"><i data-lucide="plus"></i></button></div>
      <div class="drops">${Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>`<i class="drop ${i<t.water?'on':''}"></i>`).join('')}</div><div class="s" style="margin-top:8px"><b style="color:var(--blue)">${t.water}</b> / 8 gelas</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card rina-card anim">
    <div class="m rina-full"></div>
    <span class="tag"><i data-lucide="sparkles"></i>RINA AI COACH</span>
    <h4>${esc(rl[0])}</h4><p>${esc(rl[1])}</p>
    <button class="btn btn-pri" data-rina="Analisa aktivitasku hari ini dong"><i data-lucide="message-circle"></i>Tanya RINA</button>
  </div>

  <div class="sec-h anim"><h3>Rutinitas harian</h3><button id="manageRt">${dn}/${d.routines.length} selesai<i data-lucide="chevron-right"></i></button></div>
  <div class="hscroll">${d.routines.map((r,i)=>routineCard(r,i===nIdx)).join('')}<button class="rt-add" id="addRt"><span class="p"><i data-lucide="plus"></i></span>Tambah</button></div>`;
}
function updateHomeLive(){
  if(S.page!=='home'||!$('#hSteps'))return;
  const t=liveToday(),g=S.data.user.goal;
  $('#hSteps').textContent=fmtN(t.steps);$('#hMin').textContent=fmtN(t.minutes);$('#hKcal').textContent=fmtN(t.kcal);
  $('#hDist').textContent=fmtKm(t.distance);$('#hPct').textContent=Math.round(t.steps/g*100)+'%';
  if(t.heart)$('#hBpm').textContent=t.heart;
  [[66,t.steps/g],[51,t.minutes/GOAL_MIN],[36,t.kcal/GOAL_KCAL]].forEach(([r,p],i)=>{const C=2*Math.PI*r,el=$('#rg'+i);if(el)el.style.strokeDashoffset=C*(1-Math.min(1,p))});
}

/* ============================ LIVE TRACKING ============================
   • Langkah  : accelerometer HP (DeviceMotion) → deteksi puncak ayunan
   • Jarak    : GPS (watchPosition); jika GPS lemah → langkah × panjang langkah
   • Jalan/Lari: otomatis dari cadence (langkah/menit) & kecepatan GPS
   • Jantung  : Bluetooth (smartwatch/chest strap) atau kamera (PPG)
   • Data dikirim ke Spreadsheet tiap 20 detik
   ====================================================================== */
const L={on:false,paused:false,mode:'auto',sec:0,act:0,steps:0,distGps:0,kcal:0,hrSum:0,hrN:0,
  pend:{steps:0,dist:0,kcal:0,sec:0},synced:{dist:0},lastSync:0,syncedAt:'',syncing:false,
  motion:false,gps:false,stepT:[],streak:[],cad:0,speed:0,det:'idle',lastPos:null,watch:null,wake:null,iv:null,cadHist:[],lastHr:0};
const F={mag:9.8,avg:9.8,last:0,above:false};
const DET={idle:['Diam','pause','idle'],walk:['Berjalan','footprints','walk'],run:['Berlari','zap','run'],cycle:['Bersepeda','bike','cycle']};
const MODES=['auto','walk','run','cycle','strength','stretch','yoga','hiit','swim'];

function onMotion(e){
  if(!L.on||L.paused)return;const a=e.accelerationIncludingGravity;if(!a||a.x==null)return;
  L.motion=true;const m=Math.sqrt(a.x*a.x+a.y*a.y+a.z*a.z),now=performance.now();
  F.mag=F.mag*.55+m*.45;F.avg=F.avg*.985+m*.015;const d=F.mag-F.avg;
  if(!F.above&&d>1.1&&now-F.last>270){F.above=true;F.last=now;stepDetected(now)}
  else if(F.above&&d<.25)F.above=false;
}
function stepDetected(now){
  // anti-goyang: langkah baru dihitung setelah 4 ayunan beruntun (jeda < 2 dtk)
  if(L.streak.length&&now-L.streak[L.streak.length-1]>2000)L.streak=[];
  L.streak.push(now);
  if(L.streak.length===4){addSteps(4)}else if(L.streak.length>4){addSteps(1)}
}
function addSteps(n){const now=performance.now();L.steps+=n;L.pend.steps+=n;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)L.stepT.push(now);if(L.streak.length>8)L.streak=L.streak.slice(-5)}
function haversine(a,b){const R=6371e3,t=x=>x*Math.PI/180,dLa=t(b.latitude-a.latitude),dLo=t(b.longitude-a.longitude);
  const h=Math.sin(dLa/2)**2+Math.cos(t(a.latitude))*Math.cos(t(b.latitude))*Math.sin(dLo/2)**2;return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h))}
function onPos(p){
  if(!L.on)return;const c=p.coords;L.gps=c.accuracy<=40;if(L.paused||c.accuracy>40)return;
  if(L.lastPos){const d=haversine(L.lastPos,c),dt=(p.timestamp-L.lastPos.ts)/1000;
    if(d>=3&&dt>0&&d/dt<15){L.distGps+=d;L.speed=c.speed!=null&&c.speed>=0?c.speed:d/dt;L.lastPos={latitude:c.latitude,longitude:c.longitude,ts:p.timestamp}}}
  else L.lastPos={latitude:c.latitude,longitude:c.longitude,ts:p.timestamp};
}
function strideM(){const h=(S.data.user.height||168)/100;return L.det==='run'?h*.65:h*.415}
L.distStep=0;
function totalDist(){return Math.max(L.distGps,L.distStep)}
function tick(){
  if(!L.on||L.paused)return;
  L.sec++;const now=performance.now();
  L.stepT=L.stepT.filter(t=>now-t<10000);L.cad=L.stepT.length*6;
  if(now-(L.lastPosT||0)>8000)L.speed*=.7;
  let det='idle';
  if(L.mode==='auto'){
    if(L.speed>4.2&&L.cad<60)det='cycle';else if(L.cad>=135||L.speed>2.6)det='run';else if(L.cad>=25||L.speed>.7)det='walk';
  }else det=['walk','run','cycle'].includes(L.mode)?L.mode:'walk';
  L.det=det;
  const stepsDelta=L.stepT.filter(t=>now-t<1000).length;L.distStep+=stepsDelta*strideM();
  const type=L.mode==='auto'?det:L.mode, activeNow=L.mode!=='auto'||det!=='idle';
  if(activeNow){L.act++;L.pend.sec++;const k=(KCAL_MIN[type]||4)/60*wkg();L.kcal+=k;L.pend.kcal+=k}
  const dNow=totalDist();L.pend.dist=Math.max(0,dNow-L.synced.dist);
  L.cadHist.push(L.cad);if(L.cadHist.length>60)L.cadHist.shift();
  if(Date.now()-L.lastSync>20000)liveFlush();
  liveUI();updateHomeLive();
  if(L.sec===6&&!L.motion&&['auto','walk','run'].includes(L.mode))toast(HAS_GAS?'Sensor gerak diblokir di mode Apps Script — pakai tombol "Buka VITA Full" di atas.':'Sensor gerak belum terbaca. Izinkan akses Gerakan & Orientasi di browser.','err');
}
async function liveFlush(final){
  if(L.syncing&&!final)return;L.lastSync=Date.now();
  const p={steps:L.pend.steps,kcal:Math.round(L.pend.kcal),minutes:Math.floor(L.pend.sec/60),distance:Math.round(L.pend.dist)};
  const hrNow=HR.bpm&&Date.now()-HR.at<15000?HR.bpm:0;
  if(hrNow&&Date.now()-L.lastHr>55000){p.heart=hrNow;p.heartSource=HR.src;L.lastHr=Date.now()}
  if(final)return p;
  if(!p.steps&&!p.kcal&&!p.minutes&&!p.distance&&!p.heart)return;
  L.syncing=true;
  const sent={steps:p.steps,kcal:p.kcal,sec:p.minutes*60,dist:p.distance};
  const r=await run('liveSync',[S.token,p],null,true);L.syncing=false;
  if(r){L.pend.steps-=sent.steps;L.pend.kcal-=sent.kcal;L.pend.sec-=sent.sec;L.synced.dist+=sent.dist;L.pend.dist=Math.max(0,totalDist()-L.synced.dist);
    S.data.today=r.today;L.syncedAt=r.syncedAt;liveUI()}
}
async function startLive(){
  if(L.on&&L.paused){L.paused=false;liveUI();return}
  if(typeof DeviceMotionEvent!=='undefined'&&typeof DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission==='function'){
    try{const s=await DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission();if(s!=='granted')toast('Izin sensor gerak ditolak — langkah tidak bisa dihitung','err')}catch(e){}
  }
  Object.assign(L,{on:true,paused:false,sec:0,act:0,steps:0,distGps:0,distStep:0,kcal:0,hrSum:0,hrN:0,pend:{steps:0,dist:0,kcal:0,sec:0},synced:{dist:0},
    lastSync:Date.now(),syncedAt:'',motion:false,gps:false,stepT:[],streak:[],cad:0,speed:0,det:'idle',lastPos:null,cadHist:[],lastHr:0});
  window.addEventListener('devicemotion',onMotion);
  if(navigator.geolocation&&['auto','walk','run','cycle'].includes(L.mode)){
    L.watch=navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p=>{L.lastPosT=performance.now();onPos(p)},e=>{L.gps=false;if(e.code===1)toast('Izin lokasi ditolak — jarak dihitung dari langkah','info')},{enableHighAccuracy:true,maximumAge:0,timeout:20000});
  }
  wakeOn();L.iv=setInterval(tick,1000);
  toast('Live tracking dimulai! Pegang HP / simpan di saku 🏃','ok');render();
}
async function wakeOn(){try{if('wakeLock' in navigator)L.wake=await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible'&&L.on)wakeOn()});
function pauseLive(){L.paused=!L.paused;toast(L.paused?'Dijeda':'Lanjut lagi!','info');liveUI()}
async function stopLive(save=true){
  clearInterval(L.iv);window.removeEventListener('devicemotion',onMotion);
  if(L.watch!=null)navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(L.watch);L.watch=null;
  try{L.wake&&L.wake.release()}catch(e){}
  const delta=await liveFlush(true);const was=L.on;L.on=false;L.paused=false;
  if(!save||!was||!S.token){render();return}
  if(L.sec<20){const r=(delta.steps||delta.kcal||delta.distance)?await run('liveSync',[S.token,delta],null,true):null;
    if(r){const d2=await run('getDashboard',[S.token],null,true);if(d2)S.data=d2}
    toast('Sesi singkat — langkah tetap tercatat, riwayat sesi tidak dibuat','info');render();return}
  const type=L.mode==='auto'?(L.steps&&totalDist()/Math.max(1,L.act)>2.4?'run':(L.speed>4.2&&L.steps<50?'cycle':'walk')):L.mode;
  const r=await run('finishSession',[S.token,{type,minutes:L.act/60||L.sec/60,kcal:L.kcal,steps:L.steps,distance:totalDist(),avgHR:L.hrN?L.hrSum/L.hrN:0,delta}]);
  if(r){apply(r,`Sesi tersimpan: ${fmtN(L.steps)} langkah · ${fmtKm(totalDist())} km · ${fmtN(L.kcal)} kcal 🔥`);confetti()}
}
const fmtT=s=>{const h=Math.floor(s/3600),m=Math.floor(s%3600/60),x=s%60;return(h?h+':':'')+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(x).padStart(2,'0')};
function pace(){const d=totalDist();if(d<20||!L.act)return'--';const p=L.act/60/(d/1000);if(p>40)return'--';return Math.floor(p)+"'"+String(Math.round(p%1*60)).padStart(2,'0')+'"'}
function fullLink(){const s=S.sync||{};return s.fullUrl?s.fullUrl.replace(/#.*$/,'')+'#api='+encodeURIComponent(s.url||''):''}
function fullBanner(){
  if(!HAS_GAS)return '';
  const l=fullLink();
  return `<div class="fullban anim"><span class="ic"><i data-lucide="rocket"></i></span><div><b>Pakai VITA versi penuh</b>
    <p>Google membatasi kamera & sensor gerak di halaman Apps Script. Di versi penuh, langkah, GPS & kamera jalan normal — data tetap ke spreadsheet yang sama.</p>
    ${l?`<a href="${esc(l)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i data-lucide="external-link"></i>Buka VITA Full</a>`:`<p style="margin-top:6px"><b style="display:inline;font-size:12px">Admin:</b> isi <code>FULL_APP_URL</code> di Code.gs (alamat GitHub Pages).</p>`}</div></div>`;
}
function pLive(d){
  const recent=d.recentWorkouts;
  return `
  <div class="page-h anim"><small><i data-lucide="radio"></i>Realtime dari sensor HP</small><h2>Live Tracking</h2></div>
  ${fullBanner()}
  <div class="sensors anim" id="sensors"></div>
  <div class="modes anim">${MODES.map(k=>{const t=k==='auto'?{n:'Auto',i:'sparkles'}:TYPES[k];return `<button class="mode ${L.mode===k?'on':''}" data-mode="${k}"><span class="ic t-${k}"><i data-lucide="${t.i}"></i></span>${t.n}</button>`}).join('')}</div>
  <div class="card glass live-main anim">
    <div class="lv-ring" id="lvRing"><div class="core"></div>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 236 236"><circle class="bg" cx="118" cy="118" r="104"/><circle class="fg" id="lvFg" cx="118" cy="118" r="104" stroke-dasharray="${2*Math.PI*104}" stroke-dashoffset="${2*Math.PI*104}"/></svg>
      <div class="lv-c"><div class="st" id="lvSteps">0</div><small>langkah sesi ini</small><div class="tm"><i data-lucide="timer"></i><span id="lvTime">00:00</span></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="detect" id="lvDet"><i data-lucide="pause"></i>Siap</div>
    <div class="lv-grid">
      <div><b id="lvDist">0,00</b><span><i data-lucide="map-pin"></i>km</span></div>
      <div><b id="lvPace">--</b><span><i data-lucide="gauge"></i>pace/km</span></div>
      <div><b id="lvCad">0</b><span><i data-lucide="activity"></i>langkah/mnt</span></div>
      <div><b id="lvKcal">0</b><span><i data-lucide="flame"></i>kcal</span></div>
      <div><b id="lvBpm" style="color:var(--rose)">--</b><span><i data-lucide="heart"></i>bpm</span></div>
      <div><b id="lvAct">0</b><span><i data-lucide="timer"></i>mnt aktif</span></div>
    </div>
    <canvas class="wave" id="lvWave" width="600" height="112"></canvas>
    <div class="ctrls">
      <button class="round sec" id="lvHr" title="Hubungkan detak jantung"><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i></button>
      <button class="round main" id="lvMain"><i data-lucide="play"></i></button>
      <button class="round sec" id="lvPause" title="Jeda"><i data-lucide="pause"></i></button>
    </div>
    <div class="syncline" id="lvSync"><i data-lucide="cloud"></i>Tekan ▶ untuk mulai. Data tersimpan otomatis ke Spreadsheet.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="card glass how anim">
    <h4><i data-lucide="info" style="color:var(--pri)"></i>Cara kerjanya</h4>
    <div class="how-item"><span class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="smartphone"></i></span><div><b>Langkah — sensor gerak HP</b><p>Accelerometer membaca ayunan tubuh tiap langkah. Simpan HP di saku/genggaman. Layar dijaga tetap menyala selama sesi.</p></div></div>
    <div class="how-item"><span class="ic c-mint"><i data-lucide="navigation"></i></span><div><b>Jarak & kecepatan — GPS</b><p>Dipakai untuk jarak, pace & membedakan jalan / lari / sepeda secara otomatis (mode Auto).</p></div></div>
    <div class="how-item"><span class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i></span><div><b>Detak jantung</b><p>Dari smartwatch/chest strap via Bluetooth, atau ukur pakai kamera HP (ujung jari menutup kamera + flash).</p></div></div>
    <div class="how-item"><span class="ic c-blue"><i data-lucide="watch"></i></span><div><b>Apple Watch / iPhone Health</b><p>Sinkron otomatis lewat aplikasi Pintasan (Shortcuts). Panduannya ada di menu Profil.</p></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec-h anim"><h3>Riwayat sesi</h3></div>
  <div class="list">${recent.length?recent.map(w=>{const t=TYPES[w.type]||TYPES.walk;return `
    <div class="li glass anim"><span class="ic t-${esc(w.type)}"><i data-lucide="${t.i}"></i></span>
      <div class="tx"><b>${t.n}${w.source==='live'?' · Live':''}</b><span>${esc(w.date)} · ${w.minutes} mnt${w.steps?` · ${fmtN(w.steps)} langkah`:''}</span></div>
      <div class="r">${fmtN(w.kcal)} kcal<small>${w.distance?fmtKm(w.distance)+' km':''}</small></div></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="empty">Belum ada sesi. Tekan ▶ untuk mulai!</div>'}</div>`;
}
function liveUI(){
  const pill=$('#livePill');if(pill)pill.classList.toggle('hidden',!L.on);
  if(S.page!=='live'||!$('#lvSteps'))return;
  const hrOk=HR.bpm&&Date.now()-HR.at<15000;
  $('#sensors').innerHTML=[
    [L.motion?'ok':L.on?'warn':'','smartphone',L.motion?'Gerak aktif':'Sensor gerak'],
    [L.gps?'ok':L.on&&L.watch!=null?'warn':'','navigation',L.gps?'GPS akurat':'GPS'],
    [hrOk?'ok':'','heart-pulse',hrOk?(HR.src||'Jantung'):'Jantung'],
    [L.syncedAt?'ok':'','cloud',L.syncedAt?'Sinkron '+L.syncedAt.slice(0,5):'Sinkron']
  ].map(([c,i,t])=>`<span class="sn ${c}"><i data-lucide="${i}"></i>${t}</span>`).join('');
  $('#lvSteps').textContent=fmtN(L.steps);$('#lvTime').textContent=fmtT(L.sec);
  $('#lvDist').textContent=fmtKm(totalDist());$('#lvPace').textContent=pace();$('#lvCad').textContent=L.cad;
  $('#lvKcal').textContent=fmtN(L.kcal);$('#lvAct').textContent=Math.floor(L.act/60);
  $('#lvBpm').textContent=hrOk?HR.bpm:'--';
  const C=2*Math.PI*104;$('#lvFg').style.strokeDashoffset=L.on?C*(1-((L.sec%60)/60||(L.sec?1:0))):C;
  $('#lvRing').classList.toggle('run',L.on&&!L.paused);
  const dt=L.on?(L.paused?['Dijeda','pause','idle']:(L.mode==='auto'?DET[L.det]:[ (TYPES[L.mode]||{}).n,(TYPES[L.mode]||{}).i,L.det])):['Siap','play-circle','idle'];
  const de=$('#lvDet');de.className='detect '+dt[2];de.innerHTML=`<i data-lucide="${dt[1]}"></i>${dt[0]}${L.on&&L.mode==='auto'&&!L.paused?' · Auto':''}`;
  const mb=$('#lvMain');mb.classList.toggle('stop',L.on);mb.innerHTML=`<i data-lucide="${L.on?'square':'play'}"></i>`;
  $('#lvPause').innerHTML=`<i data-lucide="${L.paused?'play':'pause'}"></i>`;$('#lvPause').style.visibility=L.on?'visible':'hidden';
  $('#lvSync').innerHTML=L.on?`<i data-lucide="cloud"></i>${L.syncedAt?'Tersinkron ke Spreadsheet '+L.syncedAt:'Sinkron otomatis tiap 20 detik…'} · ${fmtN(L.pend.steps)} langkah antre`:'<i data-lucide="cloud"></i>Tekan ▶ untuk mulai. Data tersimpan otomatis ke Spreadsheet.';
  icons();drawWave();
}
function drawWave(){
  const c=$('#lvWave');if(!c)return;const x=c.getContext('2d'),W=c.width,H=c.height,h=L.cadHist;
  x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,0);g.addColorStop(0,'#22D3EE');g.addColorStop(1,'#2563EB');
  x.strokeStyle='#E6EEF7';x.lineWidth=2;x.setLineDash([6,8]);x.beginPath();x.moveTo(0,H-8);x.lineTo(W,H-8);x.stroke();x.setLineDash([]);
  if(h.length<2){return}
  const max=Math.max(160,...h);x.beginPath();
  h.forEach((v,i)=>{const px=i/(59)*W,py=H-8-(v/max)*(H-20);i?x.lineTo(px,py):x.moveTo(px,py)});
  x.strokeStyle=g;x.lineWidth=4;x.lineJoin='round';x.stroke();
  x.lineTo((h.length-1)/59*W,H);x.lineTo(0,H);x.closePath();const a=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);a.addColorStop(0,'rgba(14,165,233,.22)');a.addColorStop(1,'rgba(14,165,233,0)');x.fillStyle=a;x.fill();
}

/* ============================ DETAK JANTUNG ============================ */
const HR={bpm:0,src:'',at:0,ble:null,live:false,lastLog:0};
function setHR(bpm,src){
  if(!bpm||bpm<30||bpm>230)return;HR.bpm=bpm;HR.src=src;HR.at=Date.now();HR.live=src==='Bluetooth';
  if(L.on&&!L.paused){L.hrSum+=bpm;L.hrN++}
  if(!L.on&&HR.live&&Date.now()-HR.lastLog>60000){HR.lastLog=Date.now();api('logHeart',S.token,bpm,'bluetooth').then(r=>{if(r&&r.ok)S.data=r})}
  if($('#hBpm'))$('#hBpm').textContent=bpm;if($('#lvBpm'))$('#lvBpm').textContent=bpm;
}
function openHeart(){
  openSheet(`<h4>Ukur detak jantung</h4><p class="desc">Pilih sumber data. Hasil otomatis tersimpan ke riwayat jantungmu.</p>
    ${fullBanner()}<button class="opt" id="hoCam"><span class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="camera"></i></span><div><b>Kamera HP (±20 detik)</b><span>Tutup kamera belakang & flash dengan ujung jari. Estimasi, bukan alat medis.</span></div></button>
    <button class="opt" id="hoBle"><span class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="bluetooth"></i></span><div><b>${HR.ble?'Terhubung ✓ — putuskan':'Smartwatch / chest strap (Bluetooth)'}</b><span>Realtime terus-menerus. Perangkat harus mendukung "heart rate broadcast" (mis. chest strap, Garmin, Polar). Chrome Android/PC.</span></div></button>
    <button class="opt" id="hoMan"><span class="ic c-blue"><i data-lucide="keyboard"></i></span><div><b>Input manual</b><span>Ketik angka dari smartwatch / tensimeter digital.</span></div></button>
    <button class="opt" data-gosync><span class="ic c-navy"><i data-lucide="watch"></i></span><div><b>Apple Watch / iPhone Health</b><span>Sinkron otomatis via aplikasi Pintasan — lihat panduan di Profil.</span></div></button>`,()=>{
    $('#hoCam').onclick=openPPG;$('#hoBle').onclick=()=>{closeSheet();HR.ble?disconnectBLE():connectBLE()};
    $('#hoMan').onclick=openManualHR;$('[data-gosync]').onclick=()=>{closeSheet();go('profile');setTimeout(()=>$('#syncCard')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}),600)};
  });
}
function openManualHR(){
  openSheet(`<h4>Input detak jantung</h4><p class="desc">Sebaiknya diukur saat istirahat (duduk tenang 5 menit).</p>
    <div class="field"><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i><input type="number" id="mHr" placeholder="contoh: 72" inputmode="numeric"></div>
    <div class="row2"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="mHrC">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-pri" id="mHrS"><i data-lucide="check"></i>Simpan</button></div>`,()=>{
    $('#mHrC').onclick=closeSheet;
    $('#mHrS').onclick=async e=>{const v=+$('#mHr').value;if(v<30||v>230)return toast('Isi angka 30–230 bpm','err');
      const r=await run('logHeart',[S.token,v,'manual'],e.currentTarget);if(r){setHR(v,'manual');closeSheet();apply(r,'Detak jantung tersimpan ❤️')}};
  });
}
async function connectBLE(){
  if(!navigator.bluetooth)return toast('Browser ini belum mendukung Bluetooth web. Pakai Chrome di Android/PC, atau ukur via kamera.','err');
  try{
    const dev=await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({filters:[{services:['heart_rate']}]});
    toast('Menghubungkan ke '+(dev.name||'perangkat')+'…','info');
    const srv=await dev.gatt.connect(),svc=await srv.getPrimaryService('heart_rate'),ch=await svc.getCharacteristic('heart_rate_measurement');
    await ch.startNotifications();
    ch.addEventListener('characteristicvaluechanged',e=>{const v=e.target.value,f=v.getUint8(0);setHR(f&1?v.getUint16(1,true):v.getUint8(1),'Bluetooth')});
    dev.addEventListener('gattserverdisconnected',()=>{HR.ble=null;HR.live=false;toast('Perangkat jantung terputus','info')});
    HR.ble=dev;toast('Terhubung! Detak jantung tampil realtime ❤️','ok');
  }catch(e){if(e.name!=='NotFoundError')toast('Bluetooth gagal: '+e.message,'err')}
}
function disconnectBLE(){try{HR.ble.gatt.disconnect()}catch(e){}HR.ble=null;HR.live=false}

/* ---- Kamera PPG: perubahan warna merah ujung jari mengikuti aliran darah ---- */
const PPG={stream:null,raf:0,s:[],t0:0,res:0,frame:0};
function openPPG(){
  openSheet(`<div class="ppg"><h4>Ukur via kamera</h4><p class="desc" style="margin-bottom:6px">Tutup <b>kamera belakang & flash</b> dengan ujung jari telunjuk. Tahan diam ±20 detik.</p>
    <div class="ppg-ring"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200"><circle class="bg" cx="100" cy="100" r="88"/><circle class="fg" id="ppgFg" cx="100" cy="100" r="88" stroke-dasharray="${2*Math.PI*88}" stroke-dashoffset="${2*Math.PI*88}"/></svg>
      <div class="c"><i data-lucide="heart"></i><b id="ppgBpm">--</b><small>bpm</small></div></div>
    <canvas id="ppgWave" width="600" height="140"></canvas><div class="ppg-st" id="ppgSt">Menyalakan kamera…</div>
    <div id="ppgAlt" class="hidden" style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <div class="tip cyan" style="text-align:left;margin:0 0 10px"><b>Cara rekam (iPhone):</b><br>1. Tekan tombol di bawah → pilih <b>Ambil Video</b>.<br>2. Nyalakan <b>flash (⚡) = Nyala</b> di kamera.<br>3. Tutup kamera belakang + flash dengan ujung jari, rekam <b>±20 detik</b>, tahan diam.<br>4. Tekan <b>Gunakan Video</b> — VITA menghitung BPM otomatis.</div>
      <label class="btn btn-pri" style="cursor:pointer"><i data-lucide="video"></i>Rekam video 20 detik<input type="file" id="ppgFile" accept="video/*" capture="environment" hidden></label>
    </div>
    <div class="row2"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="ppgC">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-pri" id="ppgS" disabled><i data-lucide="check"></i>Simpan</button></div></div>`,()=>{
    $('#ppgC').onclick=()=>{stopPPG();closeSheet()};
    $('#ppgS').onclick=async e=>{const v=PPG.res;if(!v)return;const r=await run('logHeart',[S.token,v,'kamera'],e.currentTarget);if(r){setHR(v,'kamera');stopPPG();closeSheet();apply(r,`Detak jantung ${v} bpm tersimpan ❤️`)}};
    startPPG();
  },stopPPG);
}
async function startPPG(){
  const st=m=>{const e=$('#ppgSt');if(e)e.textContent=m};
  const alt=m=>{st(m);$('#ppgAlt')?.classList.remove('hidden');const f=$('#ppgFile');if(f)f.onchange=()=>f.files[0]&&ppgFromVideo(f.files[0]);icons()};
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)return alt('Kamera langsung tidak didukung — pakai rekam video 👇');
  try{PPG.stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:{facingMode:{ideal:'environment'},width:{ideal:320},height:{ideal:240},frameRate:{ideal:30}},audio:false})}
  catch(e){return alt(HAS_GAS?'Kamera langsung diblokir Google di mode Apps Script. Pakai rekam video 👇 (atau VITA Full).':'Kamera tidak bisa diakses ('+e.name+'). Izinkan kamera, atau pakai rekam video 👇')}
  const tr=PPG.stream.getVideoTracks()[0];try{await tr.applyConstraints({advanced:[{torch:true}]})}catch(e){}
  const v=$('#ppgV');v.srcObject=PPG.stream;try{await v.play()}catch(e){}
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=40;cv.height=30;const x=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  PPG.s=[];PPG.t0=performance.now();PPG.res=0;PPG.frame=0;const C=2*Math.PI*88;
  const loop=()=>{
    if(!PPG.stream)return;PPG.frame++;
    if(v.readyState>=2){
      x.drawImage(v,0,0,40,30);const p=x.getImageData(0,0,40,30).data;let r=0,g=0,b=0;
      for(let i=0;i<p.length;i+=4){r+=p[i];g+=p[i+1];b+=p[i+2]}const n=p.length/4;r/=n;g/=n;b/=n;
      const t=performance.now(),finger=r>70&&r>g*1.35&&r>b*1.35;
      if(!finger){if(PPG.s.length)st('Jari bergeser — tutup kamera lagi');else st('Letakkan ujung jari menutupi kamera…');PPG.s=[];PPG.t0=t}
      else{PPG.s.push({t,v:r});const el=(t-PPG.t0)/1000;st(el<20?`Tahan diam… ${Math.ceil(20-el)} detik`:'Selesai!');
        $('#ppgFg').style.strokeDashoffset=C*(1-Math.min(1,el/20));
        if(el>6&&PPG.frame%15===0){const b2=calcBPM(PPG.s.filter(o=>t-o.t<12000));if(b2){$('#ppgBpm').textContent=b2;PPG.res=b2}}
        if(el>=20){const fin=calcBPM(PPG.s.filter(o=>t-o.t<15000));if(fin){PPG.res=fin;$('#ppgBpm').textContent=fin;st('Hasil: '+fin+' bpm ✓ (estimasi)');$('#ppgS').disabled=false;drawPPG();stopPPG(true);return}
          else{st('Sinyal kurang jelas, ulangi — tekan jari lebih rapat');PPG.s=[];PPG.t0=t}}}
      drawPPG();
    }
    PPG.raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  };loop();
}
/* Hitung BPM dari video rekaman (cadangan bila kamera langsung diblokir) */
async function ppgFromVideo(file){
  const st=m=>{const e=$('#ppgSt');if(e)e.textContent=m};
  $('#ppgAlt')?.classList.add('hidden');st('Menganalisa video… tunggu sebentar');
  const v=document.createElement('video');v.muted=true;v.playsInline=true;v.setAttribute('playsinline','');v.preload='auto';
  v.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:2px;height:2px;opacity:.01;left:0;top:0';document.body.appendChild(v);
  v.src=URL.createObjectURL(file);
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=40;cv.height=30;const x=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  PPG.s=[];PPG.res=0;const C=2*Math.PI*88;let last=-1,bad=0;
  const done=()=>{
    URL.revokeObjectURL(v.src);v.remove();
    const s=PPG.s.filter(o=>o.f);const use=s.slice(Math.floor(s.length*.15));      // buang 15% awal (jari masih menyesuaikan)
    const bpm=calcBPM(use);
    if(bpm){PPG.res=bpm;$('#ppgBpm').textContent=bpm;st('Hasil: '+bpm+' bpm ✓ (estimasi)');$('#ppgS').disabled=false;$('#ppgFg').style.strokeDashoffset=0}
    else{st(bad>s.length?'Jari tidak menutupi kamera dengan rapat. Ulangi dengan flash menyala.':'Sinyal kurang jelas — ulangi, tahan diam ±20 detik.');$('#ppgAlt')?.classList.remove('hidden')}
    drawPPG();
  };
  const grab=()=>{
    if(v.currentTime===last)return;last=v.currentTime;
    x.drawImage(v,0,0,40,30);const p=x.getImageData(0,0,40,30).data;let r=0,g=0,b=0;
    for(let i=0;i<p.length;i+=4){r+=p[i];g+=p[i+1];b+=p[i+2]}const n=p.length/4;r/=n;g/=n;b/=n;
    const f=r>60&&r>g*1.3&&r>b*1.3;if(!f)bad++;
    PPG.s.push({t:v.currentTime*1000,v:r,f});
    if(v.duration)$('#ppgFg').style.strokeDashoffset=C*(1-Math.min(1,v.currentTime/v.duration));
    if(PPG.s.length%10===0)drawPPG();
  };
  try{
    await new Promise((ok,no)=>{v.onloadeddata=ok;v.onerror=()=>no(new Error('Video tidak bisa dibaca'))});
    v.playbackRate=1;await v.play();
    if('requestVideoFrameCallback' in v){const cb=()=>{grab();if(!v.ended)v.requestVideoFrameCallback(cb)};v.requestVideoFrameCallback(cb)}
    else{const loop=()=>{grab();if(!v.ended)requestAnimationFrame(loop)};loop()}
    await new Promise(ok=>v.onended=ok);done();
  }catch(e){st('Gagal membaca video: '+e.message);$('#ppgAlt')?.classList.remove('hidden');v.remove()}
}
function calcBPM(s){
  if(s.length<90)return 0;const fs=s.length/((s[s.length-1].t-s[0].t)/1000);if(fs<10)return 0;
  const v=s.map(o=>o.v),w=Math.max(3,Math.round(fs*.6));
  const det=v.map((x,i)=>{let a=0,c=0;for(let j=Math.max(0,i-w);j<=Math.min(v.length-1,i+w);j++){a+=v[j];c++}return a/c-x});
  const y=det.map((x,i)=>((det[i-1]??x)+2*x+(det[i+1]??x))/4);
  const sd=Math.sqrt(y.reduce((a,b)=>a+b*b,0)/y.length);const gap=fs*.33,pk=[];
  for(let i=1;i<y.length-1;i++){if(y[i]>y[i-1]&&y[i]>=y[i+1]&&y[i]>.35*sd){if(!pk.length||i-pk[pk.length-1]>gap)pk.push(i);else if(y[i]>y[pk[pk.length-1]])pk[pk.length-1]=i}}
  if(pk.length<5)return 0;const iv=[];for(let i=1;i<pk.length;i++)iv.push((s[pk[i]].t-s[pk[i-1]].t)/1000);
  iv.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const bpm=Math.round(60/iv[Math.floor(iv.length/2)]);return bpm>=40&&bpm<=200?bpm:0;
}
function drawPPG(){
  const c=$('#ppgWave');if(!c)return;const x=c.getContext('2d'),W=c.width,H=c.height,s=PPG.s.slice(-150);x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);if(s.length<3)return;
  const v=s.map(o=>-o.v),mn=Math.min(...v),mx=Math.max(...v),rg=mx-mn||1;x.beginPath();
  v.forEach((y,i)=>{const px=i/(s.length-1)*W,py=H-12-(y-mn)/rg*(H-24);i?x.lineTo(px,py):x.moveTo(px,py)});
  x.strokeStyle='#F43F5E';x.lineWidth=3.5;x.lineJoin='round';x.stroke();
}
function stopPPG(keepRes){cancelAnimationFrame(PPG.raf);if(PPG.stream){PPG.stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());PPG.stream=null}if(!keepRes)PPG.res=PPG.res||0}

/* ================================ STATS ================================ */
function pStats(d){
  const w=d.week,g=d.user.goal,max=Math.max(g*1.15,...w.map(x=>x.steps))||1;
  const tot=w.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.steps,0),kc=w.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.kcal,0),mn=w.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.minutes,0),dist=w.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.distance||0),0),hit=w.filter(x=>x.steps>=g).length;
  const best=w.reduce((a,b)=>b.steps>a.steps?b:a,w[0]);const H=d.heartToday;
  let hsvg='<div class="empty" style="margin-top:10px">Belum ada data jantung hari ini. Ukur via kamera / Bluetooth.</div>';
  if(H.length>=2){const b=H.map(h=>h.bpm),lo=Math.min(...b)-5,hi=Math.max(...b)+5,W=600,Ht=120;
    const pts=b.map((v,i)=>[i/(b.length-1)*W,Ht-8-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*(Ht-16)]);
    const line=pts.map((p,i)=>(i?'L':'M')+p[0].toFixed(1)+' '+p[1].toFixed(1)).join(' ');
    hsvg=`<svg class="hchart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${Ht}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="${line} L${W} ${Ht} L0 ${Ht}Z" fill="url(#gArea)"/><path d="${line}" fill="none" stroke="#F43F5E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg>
      <div class="labels"><small>${esc(H[0].t)}</small><small></small><small>${esc(H[H.length-1].t)}</small></div>`}
  return `
  <div class="page-h anim"><small><i data-lucide="calendar"></i>7 hari terakhir</small><h2>Statistik</h2></div>
  <div class="card glass anim">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start"><div><div class="sub">Total langkah minggu ini</div><div class="big" style="margin-top:6px" data-count="${tot}">0</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${hit>=4?'c-mint':'c-cyan'}"><i data-lucide="target"></i>${hit}/7 hari</span></div>
    <div class="chart"><div class="plot">
      <div class="goal-line" style="bottom:${g/max*88}%"><span>Target ${fmtN(g)}</span></div>
      ${w.map(x=>`<div class="bar ${x.today?'today':''} ${x.steps>=g?'hit':''}"><div class="col" data-h="${Math.max(2,x.steps/max*88)}">${x.steps?`<span class="tip">${x.steps>=1000?(x.steps/1000).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'k':x.steps}</span>`:''}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div><div class="labels">${w.map(x=>`<small class="${x.today?'today':''}">${x.label}</small>`).join('')}</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card glass anim" style="margin-top:12px">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><div><div class="sub">Detak jantung hari ini</div><div class="big" style="margin-top:6px;color:var(--rose)">${d.heartStats?d.heartStats.avg:'--'}<small style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)"> bpm rata-rata</small></div></div>
      <span class="chip c-rose"><i data-lucide="heart"></i>${d.heartStats?d.heartStats.min+'–'+d.heartStats.max:'--'}</span></div>
    ${hsvg}
  </div>
  <div class="tiles">
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-cyan"><i data-lucide="trending-up"></i></div><div class="v" data-count="${tot/7}">0</div><div class="l">Rata-rata langkah/hari</div></div>
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-rose"><i data-lucide="flame"></i></div><div class="v" data-count="${kc}">0</div><div class="l">kcal terbakar</div></div>
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-mint"><i data-lucide="timer"></i></div><div class="v" data-count="${mn}">0</div><div class="l">Menit aktif</div></div>
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-blue"><i data-lucide="map"></i></div><div class="v"><span data-count="${dist/1000}" data-dec="1">0</span></div><div class="l">km ditempuh</div></div>
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-teal"><i data-lucide="trophy"></i></div><div class="v">${best.steps?best.label:'-'}</div><div class="l">Hari terbaik · ${fmtN(best.steps)}</div></div>
    <div class="card glass tile anim"><div class="ic c-navy"><i data-lucide="medal"></i></div><div class="v" data-count="${d.totalWorkouts}">0</div><div class="l">Total sesi latihan</div></div>
  </div>
  <button class="btn btn-soft anim" style="margin-top:12px" data-rina="Analisa tren aktivitasku 7 hari terakhir dan beri saran program minggu depan"><i data-lucide="sparkles"></i>Minta RINA analisa minggu ini</button>`;
}

/* =============================== PROFILE =============================== */
function bmiInfo(w,h){if(!w||!h)return null;const b=w/Math.pow(h/100,2);const c=b<18.5?['Kurus','c-blue']:b<25?['Normal','c-mint']:b<30?['Berlebih','c-cyan']:['Obesitas','c-rose'];return{v:b.toFixed(1).replace('.',','),l:c[0],c:c[1]}}
function pProfile(d){
  const u=d.user,b=bmiInfo(u.weight,u.height),p=(u.goal-1000)/29000*100;
  return `
  <div class="card glass prof-hero anim"><div class="avatar">${esc((u.name||'?')[0].toUpperCase())}</div><h3>${esc(u.name)}</h3><p>${esc(u.email)}</p>
    <div class="pstats"><div><b data-count="${d.totalSteps}">0</b><span>Total langkah</span></div><div><b data-count="${d.streak}">0</b><span>Streak</span></div><div><b data-count="${d.totalWorkouts}">0</b><span>Sesi</span></div></div></div>

  <div class="card glass anim" style="margin-top:12px">
    <span class="lbl">Target langkah harian</span>
    <div class="slider-val"><b id="goalV">${fmtN(u.goal)}</b><span class="sub">langkah/hari</span></div>
    <input type="range" id="pGoal" min="1000" max="30000" step="500" value="${u.goal}" style="--p:${p}%">
    <div style="height:16px"></div>
    <span class="lbl">Nama</span><div class="field plain"><input id="pName" value="${esc(u.name)}"></div>
    <div class="row2"><div><span class="lbl">Berat (kg)</span><div class="field plain"><input type="number" id="pW" value="${u.weight||''}"></div></div>
      <div><span class="lbl">Tinggi (cm)</span><div class="field plain"><input type="number" id="pH" value="${u.height||''}"></div></div></div>
    ${b?`<div class="bmi"><div><span class="sub">BMI</span><br><b>${b.v}</b></div><span class="tag ${b.c}">${b.l}</span></div>`:''}
    <button class="btn btn-pri" id="saveProf"><i data-lucide="save"></i>Simpan Profil</button>
  </div>

  <div class="card glass anim" style="margin-top:12px" id="syncCard">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px"><span class="ic c-navy" style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center"><i data-lucide="watch"></i></span>
      <div><b style="font-size:16px">Sinkron Apple Watch / Health</b><div class="sub">Langkah & detak jantung masuk otomatis</div></div></div>
    <div id="syncBody"><div class="empty">Memuat sync key…</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card glass anim" style="margin-top:12px">
    <span class="lbl">Ganti password</span>
    <div class="field"><i data-lucide="lock"></i><input type="password" id="pOld" placeholder="Password lama"></div>
    <div class="field"><i data-lucide="key-round"></i><input type="password" id="pNew" placeholder="Password baru (min. 6)"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-soft" id="savePw"><i data-lucide="shield-check"></i>Perbarui Password</button>
  </div>
  <button class="btn btn-ghost anim" id="btnOut" style="margin-top:12px;color:var(--rose)"><i data-lucide="log-out"></i>Keluar</button>
  <p class="sub anim" style="text-align:center;margin-top:14px">Bergabung sejak ${esc(u.createdAt||'-')} · VITA × RINA v2.0</p>`;
}
async function loadSync(){
  if(!$('#syncBody'))return;
  if(!S.sync){const r=await run('getSyncInfo',[S.token],null,true);if(!r){$('#syncBody').innerHTML='<div class="empty">Gagal memuat</div>';return}S.sync=r}
  const k=S.sync.key,url=S.sync.url||'(URL web app /exec)';
  const link=`${url}?action=sync&key=${k}&steps=`;
  const test=`${url}?action=sync&key=${k}&test=1`;
  const fl=fullLink();
  $('#syncBody').innerHTML=`
    <div class="tip cyan" style="margin-top:0">Cara kerjanya: <b>Apple Watch → app Kesehatan (Health) iPhone → Pintasan (Shortcuts) → VITA</b>. Pintasan cukup membuka 1 link berisi angka langkah & detak jantung.</div>

    <div class="phase"><span>1</span>Tes koneksi dulu</div>
    <p class="sub" style="line-height:1.5">Buka tombol ini di iPhone. Harus muncul tulisan <b>"Koneksi OK ✅"</b>. Kalau muncul halaman login Google, minta admin set deploy <b>Who has access = Anyone</b>.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-soft" style="margin-top:8px;text-decoration:none" href="${esc(test)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i data-lucide="plug-zap"></i>Tes koneksi</a>

    <div class="phase"><span>2</span>Salin link sinkron</div>
    <div class="keybox"><code>${esc(link)}</code><button data-copy="${esc(link)}"><i data-lucide="copy"></i></button></div>
    <p class="sub">Sync key: <b>${esc(k)}</b> · <a href="#" id="kReset" style="color:var(--pri-d);font-weight:700">buat ulang</a></p>

    <div class="phase"><span>3</span>Buat Pintasan "Sinkron VITA"</div>
    <p class="sub" style="line-height:1.5">Buka app <b>Pintasan</b> → tab <b>Pintasan</b> → tombol <b>+</b>. Ketik nama aksi di kolom pencarian, lalu susun 4 blok ini:</p>
    <div class="sc-blk sc-red"><b><i data-lucide="heart"></i>Cari Sampel Kesehatan <span style="opacity:.75;font-weight:600">(Find Health Samples)</span></b>Jenis: <code>Langkah / Steps</code> · Tanggal Mulai: <code>Hari Ini / Today</code></div>
    <div class="sc-blk sc-gray"><b><i data-lucide="sigma"></i>Hitung Statistik <span style="opacity:.75;font-weight:600">(Calculate Statistics)</span></b>Pilih <code>Jumlah / Sum</code> dari Sampel Kesehatan di atas</div>
    <div class="sc-blk sc-red"><b><i data-lucide="heart-pulse"></i>Cari Sampel Kesehatan</b>Jenis: <code>Detak Jantung / Heart Rate</code> · Urutkan: <code>Terbaru</code> · Batas: <code>1</code></div>
    <div class="sc-blk sc-blue"><b><i data-lucide="globe"></i>Dapatkan Isi URL <span style="opacity:.75;font-weight:600">(Get Contents of URL)</span></b>Tempel link langkah 2, lalu di ujungnya sisipkan variabel <code>Statistik</code>, ketik <code>&heart=</code>, sisipkan variabel <code>Sampel Kesehatan</code> (detak jantung).</div>
    <p class="sub" style="line-height:1.5">Hasil akhir URL: <code style="font-size:11px">…&steps=<b style="color:var(--rose)">[Statistik]</b>&heart=<b style="color:var(--rose)">[Sampel Kesehatan]</b></code>. Tekan ▶ untuk mencoba — izinkan akses Kesehatan saat ditanya.</p>

    <div class="phase"><span>4</span>Jalankan otomatis</div>
    <div class="sc-blk sc-green"><b><i data-lucide="alarm-clock"></i>Otomatisasi → + → Waktu</b>Pilih jam (mis. 12.00) · Ulangi: <code>Harian</code> · <code>Jalankan Segera</code> → pilih pintasan <b>Sinkron VITA</b>. Buat 2–3 otomatisasi (mis. 12.00, 17.00, 21.00).</div>
    <div class="tip">💡 Tidak mau ribet otomatisasi? Tambahkan pintasan ke Layar Utama, lalu tekan sekali sebelum buka VITA. Langkah memakai nilai terbesar, jadi aman dari dobel hitung.</div>
    ${fl?`<div class="tip cyan"><b>VITA Full:</b> <a href="${esc(fl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--pri-d);font-weight:800">buka di sini</a> → lalu di Safari tekan <b>Bagikan → Tambah ke Layar Utama</b> agar terasa seperti aplikasi.</div>`:''}`;
  icons();
  $$('#syncBody [data-copy]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{navigator.clipboard?.writeText(b.dataset.copy).then(()=>toast('Link disalin ✓'),()=>toast('Tekan lama teks untuk menyalin','info'))});
  $('#kReset').onclick=async e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!confirm('Buat sync key baru? Link lama di Pintasan harus diganti.'))return;const r=await run('resetSyncKey',[S.token]);if(r){S.sync=r;loadSync();toast('Sync key baru dibuat','info')}};
}

/* ============================= PAGE EVENTS ============================= */
function bindPage(){
  const on=(s,ev,f)=>{const el=$(s);if(el)el.addEventListener(ev,f)};
  $$('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(b.dataset.go));
  $$('[data-rina]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openRina(b.dataset.rina));
  // home
  $$('[data-rt]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    const id=el.dataset.rt,was=el.classList.contains('done');el.classList.toggle('done');
    const r=await run('toggleRoutine',[S.token,id]);if(!r){el.classList.toggle('done');return}
    const all=r.routines.length&&r.routines.every(x=>x.done);apply(r,was?'Rutinitas dibatalkan':'Rutinitas selesai! 🎉');if(!was&&all)confetti();
  }));
  const water=async e=>{const r=await run('saveActivity',[S.token,{water:1}],e.currentTarget);if(r)apply(r,r.today.water>=8?'Target minum tercapai! 💧':'+1 gelas air 💧')};
  on('#addWater','click',water);on('#qWater','click',water);
  on('#qHeart','click',openHeart);on('#hMeasure','click',openHeart);on('#qManual','click',openManual);
  on('#addRt','click',openRoutineSheet);on('#manageRt','click',openManageRt);
  // live
  $$('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(L.on)return toast('Hentikan sesi dulu untuk ganti mode','info');L.mode=b.dataset.mode;$$('[data-mode]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b))});
  on('#lvMain','click',()=>L.on?stopLive(true):startLive());
  on('#lvPause','click',pauseLive);on('#lvHr','click',openHeart);
  // profile
  on('#pGoal','input',e=>{const v=+e.target.value;$('#goalV').textContent=fmtN(v);e.target.style.setProperty('--p',((v-1000)/29000*100)+'%')});
  on('#saveProf','click',async e=>{const r=await run('updateProfile',[S.token,{name:$('#pName').value,goal:$('#pGoal').value,weight:$('#pW').value,height:$('#pH').value}],e.currentTarget);if(r)apply(r,'Profil tersimpan')});
  on('#savePw','click',async e=>{const r=await run('changePassword',[S.token,{oldPassword:$('#pOld').value,newPassword:$('#pNew').value}],e.currentTarget);if(r){toast(r.msg||'Password diganti');$('#pOld').value='';$('#pNew').value=''}});
  on('#btnOut','click',()=>{doLogout();toast('Sampai jumpa lagi! 👋','info')});
}

/* =============================== SHEETS =============================== */
let sheetClose=null;
function openSheet(html,bind,onClose,full){
  if(sheetClose){const f=sheetClose;sheetClose=null;f()}
  $('#sheet').classList.toggle('full',!!full);$('#sheetBody').style.cssText=full?'display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-height:0':'';
  $('#sheetBody').innerHTML=html;icons();$('#overlay').classList.add('show');$('#sheet').classList.add('show');sheetClose=onClose||null;bind&&bind();
}
function closeSheet(){$('#overlay').classList.remove('show');$('#sheet').classList.remove('show');if(sheetClose){const f=sheetClose;sheetClose=null;f()}}
$('#overlay').addEventListener('click',closeSheet);

function openManual(){
  openSheet(`<h4>Catat aktivitas manual</h4><p class="desc">Untuk aktivitas yang tidak direkam Live. Kalori dihitung otomatis dari langkah jika dikosongkan.</p>
    <span class="lbl">Langkah</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="footprints"></i><input type="number" id="aSteps" placeholder="contoh: 2500" inputmode="numeric"></div>
    <div class="qchips">${[500,1000,2500,5000].map(v=>`<button data-q="${v}">+${fmtN(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="row2"><div><span class="lbl">Menit aktif</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="timer"></i><input type="number" id="aMin" placeholder="0"></div></div>
      <div><span class="lbl">Kalori</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="flame"></i><input type="number" id="aKcal" placeholder="auto"></div></div></div>
    <span class="lbl">Jarak (meter)</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="map-pin"></i><input type="number" id="aDist" placeholder="opsional"></div>
    <div class="row2"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="aC">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-pri" id="aS"><i data-lucide="check"></i>Simpan</button></div>`,()=>{
    $$('[data-q]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=$('#aSteps');i.value=(+i.value||0)+(+b.dataset.q)});
    $('#aC').onclick=closeSheet;
    $('#aS').onclick=async e=>{const p={steps:$('#aSteps').value,minutes:$('#aMin').value,kcal:$('#aKcal').value,distance:$('#aDist').value};
      if(!+p.steps&&!+p.minutes&&!+p.kcal&&!+p.distance)return toast('Isi minimal satu data','info');
      const before=S.data.today.steps,r=await run('saveActivity',[S.token,p],e.currentTarget);
      if(r){closeSheet();apply(r,'Aktivitas tersimpan ✅');if(before<r.user.goal&&r.today.steps>=r.user.goal)setTimeout(()=>{confetti();toast('Target langkah tercapai! 🏆')},600)}};
  });
}
function openRoutineSheet(){
  let type='walk';
  openSheet(`<h4>Rutinitas baru</h4><p class="desc">Jadwal latihan harian yang bisa kamu centang setiap hari.</p>
    <div class="sel-types">${Object.entries(TYPES).map(([k,v])=>`<button data-st="${k}" class="${k===type?'on':''}"><i data-lucide="${v.i}"></i>${v.n}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <span class="lbl">Nama rutinitas</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="pencil"></i><input id="nName" placeholder="contoh: Evening jog"></div>
    <div class="row2"><div><span class="lbl">Jam</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="alarm-clock"></i><input type="time" id="nTime" value="17:00"></div></div>
      <div><span class="lbl">Durasi (mnt)</span><div class="field"><i data-lucide="timer"></i><input type="number" id="nDur" value="20"></div></div></div>
    <div class="row2"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="nC">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-pri" id="nS"><i data-lucide="plus"></i>Tambah</button></div>`,()=>{
    $$('[data-st]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{type=b.dataset.st;$$('[data-st]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b))});
    $('#nC').onclick=closeSheet;
    $('#nS').onclick=async e=>{const r=await run('addRoutine',[S.token,{name:$('#nName').value,time:$('#nTime').value,duration:$('#nDur').value,type}],e.currentTarget);if(r){closeSheet();apply(r,'Rutinitas ditambahkan ✨')}};
  });
}
function openManageRt(){
  const d=S.data;
  openSheet(`<h4>Kelola rutinitas</h4><p class="desc">Hapus rutinitas yang tidak dipakai lagi.</p>
    <div class="list">${d.routines.map(r=>{const t=TYPES[r.type]||TYPES.walk;return `<div class="li" style="background:#F6F9FD"><span class="ic t-${esc(r.type)}"><i data-lucide="${t.i}"></i></span>
      <div class="tx"><b>${esc(r.name)}</b><span>${esc(r.time)} · ${r.duration} mnt · ${t.n}</span></div><button class="del" data-del="${esc(r.id)}"><i data-lucide="trash-2"></i></button></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Belum ada rutinitas</div>'}</div>
    <button class="btn btn-soft" style="margin-top:14px" id="mAdd"><i data-lucide="plus"></i>Tambah rutinitas</button>`,()=>{
    $('#mAdd').onclick=openRoutineSheet;
    $$('[data-del]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{const r=await run('deleteRoutine',[S.token,b.dataset.del],b);if(r){S.data=r;render();openManageRt();toast('Rutinitas dihapus')}});
  });
}

/* ================================ RINA AI ================================ */
$('#rinaFab').addEventListener('click',()=>openRina());
function md(s){
  return esc(s).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'<b>$1</b>').replace(/(^|[\s(])_(.+?)_(?=[\s).,!?]|$)/g,'$1<em>$2</em>').replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,'<b>$1</b>')
    .replace(/^#{1,4}\s*(.+)$/gm,'<b>$1</b>').replace(/^\s*[-•]\s+/gm,'• ').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
}
function msgHTML(m){return m.role==='user'?`<div class="msg u">${esc(m.text)}</div>`:`<div class="mrow"><div class="av rina-head"></div><div class="msg r">${md(m.text)}</div></div>`}
function openRina(preset){
  const n=first(S.data.user.name);
  const sugg=['Analisa aktivitasku hari ini','Buat program jalan kaki 7 hari','Detak jantungku normal?','Tips fit to work sebelum shift malam','Stretching 5 menit di area kerja'];
  openSheet(`
    <div class="chat-head"><div class="av rina-head"></div><div><b>RINA • AI Coach</b><span><i></i>Online — siap bantu</span></div><button class="x" id="rClose"><i data-lucide="x"></i></button></div>
    <div class="msgs" id="msgs">
      <div class="mrow"><div class="av rina-head"></div><div class="msg r">Hai ${esc(n)}! 👋 Aku <b>RINA</b>, AI coach kebugaranmu. Aku bisa baca data langkah, kalori & detak jantungmu lalu kasih saran yang pas. Mau tanya apa?</div></div>
      ${S.chat.map(msgHTML).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="sugg">${sugg.map(s=>`<button data-sg="${esc(s)}">${esc(s)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="composer"><textarea id="rIn" rows="1" placeholder="Tulis pesan untuk RINA…"></textarea><button id="rSend"><i data-lucide="send"></i></button></div>`,()=>{
    const box=$('#msgs');box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
    $('#rClose').onclick=closeSheet;
    $$('[data-sg]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>sendRina(b.dataset.sg));
    const ta=$('#rIn');ta.addEventListener('input',()=>{ta.style.height='auto';ta.style.height=Math.min(120,ta.scrollHeight)+'px'});
    ta.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();sendRina(ta.value)}});
    $('#rSend').onclick=()=>sendRina(ta.value);
    if(preset)setTimeout(()=>sendRina(preset),400);
  },null,true);
}
let rinaBusy=false;
async function sendRina(text){
  text=String(text||'').trim();if(!text||rinaBusy)return;rinaBusy=true;
  const box=$('#msgs'),ta=$('#rIn');if(ta){ta.value='';ta.style.height='auto'}
  const hist=S.chat.slice(-10);S.chat.push({role:'user',text});
  box.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',msgHTML({role:'user',text}));
  box.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="mrow" id="typing"><div class="av rina-head"></div><div class="msg r typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>');
  box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
  const r=await run('askRina',[S.token,text,hist],null,true);rinaBusy=false;
  $('#typing')?.remove();
  const reply=r?r.reply:'Maaf, koneksi ke RINA terputus. Coba lagi sebentar ya 🙏';
  S.chat.push({role:'rina',text:reply});S.chat=S.chat.slice(-30);store.set('vita_chat_'+S.data.user.email,JSON.stringify(S.chat));
  if(box.isConnected){box.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',msgHTML({role:'rina',text:reply}));box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight}
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
